Perfect for cozy yet grand celebrations.
* Hall 1 accommodates both the event and dining within the same space
* Dining is thoughtfully arranged in a separate partitioned area
* Dining capacity: 35 guests at a time
* Fully centralised air-conditioned hall for complete comfort
* Tariff: ₹35,000 + EB charges (₹24 per unit)

fields.name: big hall
fields.description:
Warm greetings from Lotus Banquet Hall, Virugambakkam! Thank you for considering our venue for your special occasion. We’re truly excited to walk with you in creating a celebration filled with joy, comfort, and beautiful memories.
✨ Our Elegant Hall Arrangements
✨ Tailored Just for You
Grand Celebration Setup (Up to 500 Guests)
Designed for larger gatherings with smooth guest flow.
* Hall 1 dedicated exclusively for the main event
* Hall 2 reserved for dining
* Dining capacity: 75 guests at a time
* Dining hall comes with attached kitchen and washroom facilities
* Both halls are fully centralised air-conditioned
* Tariff: ₹60,000 + EB charges (₹24 per unit)

fields.name: Raveendar V
fields.comment:
Nice place to conduct Weddings or Receptions or other functions.  It's part of the Anantapadmanabha Swamy temple complex.  The hall is spacious to handle 300-400 people.  Airconditioned.  They have an AC Dining Hall also.  Parking isn't an issue.

I attended two Thirukalyanams of Sreenivasa-Padmavathy & Siva-Parvathi in the last 3 days.  Great place.

fields.name: VENKATARAMANI RENGARAMANUJAM
fields.comment: Very nice kalyana Mandapam at the  heart of Adayar adjescent to Anandha Padmanabha Swami Temple. well maintained easily accomodate 500 people at dining hall and space for car parking to a minimum.

fields.name: Sriram
fields.comment:
Quiet huge hall with elevated dais. However dining hall is too small. If there's no proper crowd management, guests are left on their own to wait standing behind people eating which is awkward.
Not more than a dozen cars can be parked. Bike parking is outside only ,could get full easily and you're left to search for spots outside nearby houses.

fields.name: Chandrappa RC
fields.comment: Medium size hall for social gathering attached to Sri Padmanabha temple in central Adyar. Very auspious location for religious functions.

fields.name: Venkat Narayan R
fields.comment: Very close to Adyar main road, serene place and next to Padmanabha Swamy temple. Wish mahaswamigal images be decorated with little flowers and put hoarding not to wear Chappel / Shoes in places images are kept

fields.name: Karthik S
fields.comment: A nice function hall with a capacity of upto 500 individuals, dining is in the 1st floor with a capacity of 300+ individuals. Very limited rooms. No escalator/ lift...limited parking provision in the front but valet parking can be opted. Road to the Hall is narrow and more like a 10ft lane, better to come by a rick. Can be better maintained but decent go!

fields.name: Gayathri shri Kashyap
fields.comment: Next to the nidhi school is the nidhi kalyan mandapam. The hall can accomodate a floating crowd of 300 to 400 people. On the first floor is the dinning which has seating capacity of 150 people along with kitchen.There is parking in the nidhi school which is near  by nidhi school. There are total of 6 rooms provided for the bride and groom

fields.name: Gowtham N
fields.comment: Close to railway station and bus stand. Spacious marriage hall. But the ambience is kind of average.

fields.name: Shiva Shiva
fields.comment: It contains a superb Marraige hall and dinner hall and also many specification are included

fields.name: Kss Narayanan
fields.comment: This marriage hall is situated in Alandur, one of the suburbs of Chennai, near Alandur Metro station.  About 250 persons can be seated inside the hall.  Spacious function conducting place.  Fully air-conditioned.  Ample space for car parking.  Suitable for marriages, discourses and other functions.  This hall is managed by a Trust.

fields.name: Rajan Kalambur
fields.comment: In the busy city centre, this hall is located. Visited during peak Carnatic music concerts lined up. Very spacious hall, function and dining got individual halls. Parking is available well decorated interiors too.

fields.name: Shivani M
fields.comment: Attended a concert at this venue. It has limited seating, and the ambience could be improved a bit. The sabha canteen (Mount Batten Mani Iyer Catering) was quite pricey, and the taste was average, we tried only dinner. However, I’ve heard there are mixed reviews, and that the lunch offerings are better.

fields.name: Saranya Rajagopal
fields.comment:
Ethiraju Kalyana Nilayam has a very big and spacious hall which is good for hosting weddings and large gatherings. The overall space inside the hall is quite comfortable for guests. However, the rooms provided are quite small and may feel a bit cramped if many people need to use them.

Car parking is available, but the parking space is limited and may not be sufficient when there are many vehicles. Overall, the hall is good for functions because of the large main space, but improvements in room size and parking capacity would make it much better

fields.name: Murali Raghavan
fields.comment: An old marriage hall at the arterial TTK road, this is now tastefully renovated. Relatively of medium size, this can hold upto 500 pax for weddings/ceremonies. The main venu & dining area are located at the ground floor with some rooms for guests at the mezzanine floor. There's a limited parking and AC facility besides other utilities. This is also a popular venue for margazhi kutcheries.

fields.name: Harihar Karthik
fields.comment: The finest destination for experiencing the finest wedding ceremony 🎑. The facilities are of those that would serve a high profile wedding. From the outside lighting, entrance door, complete granite floorings and chandeliers, everything is just captivating. The altar, when decorated, will looks alluring for any event. This is a completely Air conditioned building and there are ducts to suck the fire smokes out from the altar. The first floor, accessible by both stairs and lift, has good looking and clean rooms. The parking space alone will need some extension as not everyone's vehicles can be parked. The toilets are downstairs, which is very helpful for the elderly people. Overall, a very fulfilling experience, highly recommended.

fields.name: Pradhikrishna Pradhikrishna
fields.comment:
Wonderful Experience❤️

We recently held an engagement function here for 220 guests, and it was a smooth and joyful event from start to finish.

Drinking water and welcome drinks were provided throughout, and the welcome drink was refreshing and well-received by all.

The food arrangement was excellent. Even though around 250 guests attended, the full menu was served as promised, and everyone was satisfied with the quality and quantity.

The staff was polite and cooperative, making sure everything went as planned without any stress.

We are very happy with their service and would definitely recommend this place for any family function💯❤️

fields.name: Vishva V
fields.comment: We had a wonderful experience at this mahal💥❤️The ambience was very spacious🥳, clean and well maintained. Parking facility was good 🚘🏍️and the management team was very supportive throughout the function. Decoration and lighting gave a grand look🧨🏮⚡. Overall, it was a perfect place for weddings and family functions. Highly recommended 🙌💝😊

fields.name: Selvi Palani
fields.comment:
We recently visited this mahal for a wedding function. The place was clean and well-maintained. The stage decoration was very nice and attractive. The AC worked well throughout the event. The management was friendly and
took care of all arrangements smoothly. Parking and dining areas were also neat and properly arranged.

We highly recommend this mahal for all kinds of functions.

fields.name: Ganesan Balraj
fields.comment: Good location. Suitable for 150-200 people's function. Arrangements are good. Neat dinning and food arrangement.  Local to Ambattur residents can try here for gathering .

fields.name: Suriya Suriya
fields.comment: We are very hpy with their service and would definitely recommend this place for any family function Good ambience ♥️👍

fields.name: Mandolin Saiganesh
fields.comment: Excellent hall with spacious Car parking..Our Saiswarangal band carries lot of pleasant memories performing at this venue..

fields.name: Kss Narayanan
fields.comment: This function hall is situated on the main road in Aminjikkarai, Chennai, on Poonamallee High Road.  A spacious hall for conducting marriages and lectures etc.  500 persons can be accommodated in the hall.  Fully air-conditioned.  Ample car parking space is available.  Dining hall accommodates 200 persons.

fields.name: Dr.Navin Puttum
fields.comment:
The place is pretty new to Chennai and has lot of space. The place is difficult to locate but the place is very good.
The place has all the amenities and attributes needed for any function.
It has ample and spacious parking inside the city which is most needed right now.
It has a well built infrastructure
Good spacious hall but a max of 500 people capacity and decent rooms for the Bride and Groom.
4 rooms are available
More than 50 cars can be parked easily
Dining for more than 200 persons
Neat and tidy place

fields.name: geebumbaa
fields.comment: The convention hall on the back, could accommodate approx 150-200 for sitting and dining. Dining capacity of 50 persons at a time, makes it tough to keep the function smooth. Access to the dining must me away from the main stage. Decent hall with ample parking but congested dining space.

fields.name: Prem Kumar
fields.comment:
Neatly maintained
Amble parking for 4,2 wheelers
Amidst in Poonamallee High road
Semi circle view of seating to enjoy the stage
Spacious, air, light abundant hall

fields.name: Sagayaraj Boss
fields.comment:
Small hall. Not more than 70 members.

Dining also very tiny needs to stand behind the person in the dining.

fields.name: செல்வம் சுப்பிரமணியம்
fields.comment:
Very spacious marriage hall.
Neat and cleanly maintained.
Around 300 people can sit in hall.
250 people can sit for dining.
Car and bike parking is there.

fields.name: Niyaz Ahamed
fields.comment:
A/C hall with big dining hall area.

Ground floor: Function hall 180 to 200 members can occupy

First floor: Big Dining hall with 80 to 100 members can occupy at a time

Adv:
Big dining hall
A/C  in both function hall and dining hall
Did adv:
Small function hall
Small parking with max

fields.name: V S
fields.comment: A marriage hall that's not big enough to hold a large no Of guests beyond 200-250 with no convenient car parking space. The Ac's in the hall as well as the dining is jus not sufficient and hardly had any effect.  The dining hall in the first floor was ok when compared to the marriage hall.  Two wheeler parking is also cramped.

fields.name: Sebin Kingston
fields.comment: Likely to be suggested, i haven't experienced anything bad here.. compact and clean

fields.name: Vijayanarayanan saravanan
fields.comment:
The new hall is well-maintained and has ample parking space outside, with valet services available. We visited it for a birthday function and it comfortably accommodated over 200 people.

The dining area is spacious and adds to the overall good feel of the venue. There’s a lift inside, though it’s a bit slow but it serves its purpose.

fields.name: GOKUL NATHAN
fields.comment:
Good atmosphere and nice interior setup.

Dining hall with AC facility, comfortable for guests.

Suitable for 100–150 members functions like birthday, engagement, and small gatherings.

Staff service is good and event arrangements were neat.

Parking space is limited, so guests may need to park outside.

Location is easy to find and well-maintained surroundings.

Overall a decent hall for small to medium events.

fields.name: Sathish Kumar .T
fields.comment: Good Spacious hall. But parking space will be less. However, they are managing through vallet car parking.

fields.name: VIKRAM M
fields.comment:
(middleclass / EMI user's)
Green apple hall is most expensive one. So many of Restrictions is there in hall. But parking the vehicle very very less area. Total amount of money is not worth for(middleclass / EMI user's). Cleaning service team and rooms,toilet are excellent.

fields.name: Senthil Bagavathi
fields.comment: Great experience at this hall and staff all friendly nature good lighting and aesthetic theme

fields.name: kumara swamy
fields.comment:
The hall is suited for mid-sized occasions, comfortably accommodating around 100–150 guests. The ambience is pleasant and modern space to conduct birthday parties, social events. Seating and space arrangements are adequate, ensuring the event feels compact.

In conclusion, it provides a balanced mix of seating capacity and atmosphere, making it a vice option for functions of mid scale.

fields.name: Gopinath P
fields.comment: This Hall Was suitable for brithday parties get to gathering office seminar meetings. It is near to the Anna nagar main road

fields.name: Kripa Srinivasan
fields.comment: The hall is well maintained and very good staff. The AC works very well and easy access with lift services. Very apt for small functions.

fields.name: Arun Paul
fields.comment:
The hall is well-suited for medium-sized gatherings, comfortably accommodating around 100–150 guests. The ambience is pleasant and welcoming, making it a good choice for family functions, receptions, or social events. Seating and space arrangements are adequate, ensuring the event feels neither too crowded nor too empty.

Overall, it provides a balanced mix of capacity, comfort, and atmosphere, making it a reliable option for functions of this scale.

fields.name: I’m_A_ GiXxEr RiDeR VG_36
fields.comment:
We attended an event at Crystal Banquet Party Hall and the overall experience was okay. The hall is decent and spacious enough for small to medium gatherings. The ambiance was good and the staff were cooperative.

However, one big drawback is the lack of parking facilities. Guests had a tough time finding a place to park, which was quite inconvenient, especially during a crowded event.

With better parking arrangements, the experience would have been much smoother. A decent option, but be prepared for parking issues.

fields.name: Praveen Kumar
fields.comment:
Less than 100m from Arumbakkam metro station, the property is easily accessible and in prime area near Koyambedu.
The hall has a full capacity of 500 seaters when cramped. With comfort it can safely be said as 300 seater. There are 12 rooms in Ayswarya mahal with reasonable space for parking. The hall is fully air conditioned, led display available.

fields.name: Jayashree Anand
fields.comment:
Aishwarya Marriage Hall is a fantastic venue for weddings and receptions, especially if you are expecting a large gathering. The function hall is impressively spacious, making it ideal for big events without feeling cramped. They also have a separate dining hall, which helps in managing the crowd smoothly during mealtime. The hall is located right in the centre of the city, making it very convenient for guests coming from different areas.

The only downside is the traffic congestion around the venue, especially during peak hours, which can make reaching the place a bit challenging. However, once you get there, the space and facilities definitely make up for it. Overall, a great choice for grand celebrations!

fields.name: Selvam Mohanraj
fields.comment: Marriage hall located in main road, enough parking space, spacious hall and dining hall. Dining hall located in ground floor, marriage hall located in first floor. There has no lift. Large stage. Interior design were nice. Restroom were neat and clean.

fields.name: R.S. ANANTHAN
fields.comment: Good air-conditioned Mahal. In  marriage hall the display T.V. is not functioning. No proper reply from Manager..... Situated on 100ft road. Always traffic congestion.

fields.name: Sridevi Sridharan
fields.comment: If there's an option to give zero, I would give for the items put for sales on 02/14 & 02/15. None of the items worth for the hype n marketing done in the social media. Just added one pic for sample.

fields.name: Gabriel Devaraj
fields.comment:
Lakshmi Marriage Hall in Ashok Nagar is an excellent venue for weddings and other celebrations. The hall is spacious, well-maintained, and equipped with all the necessary facilities to host a grand event. The ambiance is elegant, with good lighting and comfortable seating arrangements.

One of the standout features is the cleanliness and hygiene maintained throughout the venue, including the dining area and restrooms. The air conditioning ensures a comfortable experience for guests, even during large gatherings. The parking space is also sufficient, which is a big plus in a busy area like Ashok Nagar.

The staff is courteous and cooperative, making sure that everything runs smoothly. The stage setup and decoration options available are impressive, allowing customization as per the event’s theme. The dining area is well-organized, and the food service is efficient, ensuring that guests are served promptly.

Overall, Lakshmi Marriage Hall is a great choice for weddings and other functions, offering a blend of convenience, comfort, and elegance. Highly recommended for those looking for a hassle-free and memorable event experience!

fields.name: Shyam Iyer
fields.comment: I attended an upanayan sanskar there. There was a delicious food they offered

fields.name: Ganesh Ayyanar
fields.comment: It is Air conditioned party/wedding hall near to hot chips ashok nagar signal, parking is limited, you have to park your cars and bikes near the parallel roads of this hall. It's decent hall for 200-400 pax with a dining hall in basement.

fields.name: Madhan Kumar
fields.comment: Good and Very nice compact marriage hall,at Ashok nagar,but no car parking.hall and dinning hall is very good location is on 100ft main road easy to have metro train,all ecr bus,local pillar bus stop is very near almost well

fields.name: Varghese Tony
fields.comment:
Decent hall. Can accommodate around 200 people in the hall at once. Have a basement for serving meals. The washrooms are ok. They also have rooms and dorm on the top floor.

Biggest advantage is the ease of access. It's right next to the main road and also has a road entry/exit on its side. It's also walkable distance from the Ashok Nagar metro station.

The AC is just on one side of the hall and therefore the cooling is not even across the hall. One may freeze on one side whereas sweat on the other side.

fields.name: Sathish Sekar
fields.comment: Manjula Mahal in Avadi is the epitome of elegance! With a spacious main hall accommodating 400 guests and a charming dining hall for 200, it's perfect for grand celebrations. Impeccable service and a stunning venue make it the ideal choice for memorable weddings!

fields.name: Rahul c
fields.comment: My name is Rahul Chandrasekar. I visited Manjula Mahal with my friends Pravesh, Deenu, and Manish for Varsha and Rokesh's marriage on June 15th at 11:30 p.m., but we did not have an invitation. We waited at the entrance for 30 minutes, but no one told us to move the car. Such good staff! Thank you, Manjula Mahal.

fields.name: D S Narayanan
fields.comment: Spacious Arangam for 600 + crowd, amenities are fine, rooms available.Dining hall near.

fields.name: Sundar_Appu
fields.comment: Neatly maintained hall with 2 floors where one floor for function And one for dinning. Sufficient for small functions with decent parking facilities.

fields.name: Venugopal Durairajan
fields.comment: Decent hall for marriages, functions. Can accomodate around 250 people at the same time. Has car parking both in ground floor and outside, staff help out in parking.

fields.name: Gokul Nivas
fields.comment:
We recently celebrated our engagement at GLS Mahal, and it was an unforgettable experience. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel truly special. The ambiance was warm, elegant, and perfect for such a meaningful occasion.

The food was absolutely exceptional — every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. Our guests couldn't stop raving about the menu! Special thanks to the team for accommodating our requests and making sure everything went smoothly.

If you're looking for a place to host a memorable event or even just enjoy a fantastic meal, I can't recommend Mahal enough. Thank you for being part of such an important milestone in our lives!

fields.name: Priya Andrews
fields.comment:
We recently celebrating our family function at GLS Mahal Ayanavaram. The ambience was very nice. We booked package system including all like Rent, Decorations, Naming board, catering service (veg or Non veg) , photo album etc .  Our guests told the food was delicious and the function were held very smooth. We're so happy  and
We don't have any tension about the celebration. I thank to Mr. Shankar Sir such a good Person being stand till last minute of the function.
So, I recommend the place for a small family functions around 150 People.

fields.name: vijay kdhas
fields.comment: We had celebrated my son baptism function at this mahal. Really very nice experience. We have selected package from them. Package covers every things from Mahal Rent, Welcome drink, decoration, food, photography...etc included at reasonable budget. Food Quality and Quantity are excellent. Good place to celebrate any functions in ayanavaram.

fields.name: Arjith R
fields.comment:
Here's your altered review in a new format:

"We absolutely love this hall! This is the second event we've held here from our family, and once again, it was a fantastic experience. The food was delicious, and everyone couldn't stop talking about it. The owners added a special touch with their singing and audio, making the atmosphere even more enjoyable. The arrangements were spot on, and everything went smoothly. We will definitely keep coming back for more events. Overall, it was an excellent celebration!"

fields.name: Ajith Sathiyanathan
fields.comment: Very clean organized And well Spaced Party hall that everybody can consider it, Shankar sir standing with us  Taking care of the function,They have a package also check with them, food, decoration, Welcome drink, , Photo Graphy Etc.. Every thing on your Budget. Go with out any second Thought. You wil be satisfied. Bluetooth speakers also there. Thank you Shankar sir 😊

fields.name: Vijay Natarajan
fields.comment:
Ceelam Grand Banquet is an excellent venue for special occasions! The hall is spacious, well-decorated, and perfect for weddings, receptions, and corporate events. The ambiance is elegant, with modern interiors that add a touch of sophistication.

Ensuring smooth event management. The food was delicious, with a great variety of dishes to choose from. Overall, a fantastic experience—highly recommended for anyone looking for a premium banquet hall!

fields.name: Harini Kazipeta
fields.comment:
I celebrated my daughter's birthday at Ceelam Grand Hall. The hall, lift, food service area, and locality were good. The staff were supportive. The issue was the decoration.

You are required to use their in-house decorator. I booked the venue one month in advance. They shared the decor contact immediately. I reached out and he sent previous samples. I had my own ideas, so I explained everything on WhatsApp. He asked me to visit the venue for discussion. I arranged care for my one-year-old and went there. He arrived late, spent around 15 minutes with me, took notes, and said he would share the quote. He never did. He stopped responding.

He contacted me only a day before the event and asked all the same questions again. I explained everything again. The coordinator insisted on full payment before the event.

He promised to complete the decoration by 4 pm on the event day. The event was at 6 pm. At 5.30 pm, the decoration was incomplete and the cleaning started only after we reached.

The final output was disappointing. Several elements I requested were missing. The real flowers were not placed securely and kept falling. I had shared a birthday invitation template and asked for a 3-ft baby princess cutout, but he reused the template print instead. The entrance setup was added even though I did not agree to it.

I never saw him on the event day. When I called, he said he added more work and had no profit. The result did not match the discussions or references. This part of the experience was stressful and frustrating.

Ceelam Grand Hall is a good venue, but the decoration service needs serious improvement.

fields.name: sushmitha
fields.comment: Ceelam grand is an excellent venue for special occasions. I celebrate my baby shower at Ceelam grand. The hall, food service area and locality were good. The staff Jayanthi mam is very supportive and kindness. Overall I really enjoyed my day

fields.name: vignesh pandian
fields.comment: We hosted our baby shower at CEELAM GRAND and had a fantastic experience. Big thanks to the owner for being so cooperative. The venue offers good car parking, nice AC, and delicious food. The affordable decor was exactly as promised, adding to the overall charm of the event. Highly recommend for anyone planning an event!"

fields.name: vignesh surya
fields.comment: CEELAM GRAND offers exceptional service! The car parking was hassle-free, and the staff made sure everything ran smoothly. The hall is clean, well-maintained, and the decorations by Nandha bro were elegant. The dining hall was spacious with great seating arrangements. The AC was good enough throughout the hall. In house Food was outstanding too!

fields.name: Dr. Ramya Priyadarshini
fields.comment:
Huge place with ample parking space .. well maintained hall ..
Rest rooms were clean..

fields.name: Jayashree Anand
fields.comment:
Dwaraka Palace is an excellent choice for hosting weddings and receptions, especially if you are planning a large gathering. The function hall is very spacious with a separate dining hall, ensuring a smooth flow of events. Located on East Coast Road, the venue offers a beautiful sea-facing view, adding a special charm to the celebrations.

They provide all facilities, including catering, with a delicious and well-curated sathvik menu and a truly sumptuous spread. The venue also boasts a huge car parking area, which is very convenient for guests. With plenty of beautiful spots for photos, it’s perfect for capturing all those special moments.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a grand, scenic, and hassle-free wedding venue!

fields.name: Kannammai Palaniappan
fields.comment: It is a nice place with sea view all the time. The place is huge and they have dining and buffet area which greatly reduces the queue for eating. The mahal is fully equipped with centralized ac with clean toilet facilities. Being there with a sea view gives a calmer mind and peaceful time

fields.name: Meenakshi Pradeep
fields.comment: Beautiful venue with the most organised team! Mamdapam, food, rooms and all other arrangements were exceptional. We had a great experience!

fields.name: Rajeswari Thangavelu
fields.comment: We recently hosted my daughter’s wedding at Dwaraka Palace, Tiruvanmiyur, and it was a wonderful experience. The venue has a beautiful lawn that added elegance to the celebrations, and the arrangements were grand. The service was excellent, and the food received compliments from all our guests. Truly a perfect place for a memorable wedding!

fields.name: Vm Harish
fields.comment:
​I recently attended a wedding at Sri Sastha Mahal in Chrompet (located in the Hasthinapuram area), and it is a solid choice for anyone looking for a well-maintained, mid-to-large-scale.
​The Venue Highlights
​Hall Capacity: The main hall is impressively spacious. It can comfortably accommodate about 500 seated guests, and for a floating crowd, it easily handles more. The air conditioning was effective throughout the ceremony, which is a huge plus given the Chennai heat.
​Dining Area: The dining hall is located on a separate floor and can seat roughly 200 people at a time. The flow from the main hall to the dining area was smooth, though it can get a bit crowded during the peak "muhurtham" lunch hour.
​Parking: One of the standout features is the ample car parking. Unlike many mandapams in the narrow streets of Chrompet where you have to hunt for a spot, this venue has a dedicated space that takes the stress out of arriving by car.
​Accessibility: It is situated on the main Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, making it very easy to locate for guests coming from the GST Road or the Chrompet railway station.

fields.name: KAILASI Radhakrishnan Varadarajan
fields.comment:
Excellent kalyana Mandapam
Lift facility available
3 floors available
3 rd floors having good decent rooms
Remaining 2 floors one Marriage hall second Dining Hall
Neat and clean
Don't know the per day rates

fields.name: Jordan Tech
fields.comment: A very nice marriage hall with good ambience. Nice design decoration,The hall is spacious, clean, and well maintained. Parking facility is good , a perfect place for All functions. Nice atmosphere one of the best mahal in Chromepet Hasthinapuram,

fields.name: Swaminathan G
fields.comment: Best mahal in RP road, Hasthinapuram. Good management, more ambience, vallet parking, Temple premises inside the mahal. Full Ac rooms, centralized Ac in dinning hall and marriage hall.. Very well maintained. Good neatness and cleanliness.. highly satisfied

fields.name: PUDHUSU RESTAURANT
fields.comment: One of the good mahal in hasthinapuram and chromepet surroundings. All staffs and management side good services and neatly maintained. Good cooperation. Ac hall and dinning with centralized Ac. 14 suit rooms. Vallet parking, vinayagar temple inside the mahal. Highly satisfied.

fields.name: Aravind R
fields.comment: Nice and big place, in the city centre just adjacent to the chetpet flyover from sterling road side . There is an access from Harrington road too . Centrally air conditioned hall and dining with ample car parking for around 200 cars. Rooms can be better. Easy access to this place makes it an ideal place for marriage and other functions.

fields.name: Kumaran Somasundaram
fields.comment:
Marriage hall is very neat and maintain well. Fully air-conditioned including dinning Hall. This hall can accommodate more than 500 people. Lot of parking space is available and outdoor dinning also available. Separate place for music entertainment.

Nearest metro station is kilpauk and chepet suburban train

fields.name: skanda kumar
fields.comment: Very big Hall... Ample car parking.. right in the centre of city Chetpet... Can accommodate 1000 people . Fully air conditioned... Great Experience..

fields.name: Balasubramanian Govindaraju
fields.comment: Very spacious marriage hall. Marriage hall have good seating and dining capacity. Lots of open space available to park 100+ cars.

fields.name: thrilokbabu darisa
fields.comment: Kuchalambal Marriage Hall is a spacious venue that can handle large gatherings comfortably, making it ideal for weddings and big events. The hall facilities are well-maintained and suitable for large-scale functions. However, the entrance area tends to get a bit jammed during peak hours, especially when guests arrive at the same time. With better crowd management at the entry, the overall experience can be even smoother.

fields.name: Amreen Masthan
fields.comment:
Booked meenakshi narayana function hall for my reception on 17 june ....Your function hall provided ample space to our guests and relatives and friends..

Your staffs provided excellent care right from entry to exit, disciplined in all the ways, co-operated with us and also permitted extra time..
All the rooms and restrooms were clean and hygienic.. special  thanks for Mr.mahesh and the manager Mr.vijay was kind n humble and understanding helped alot throughout....so eveyone can blindly book this function hall for all ur functions 😍😍😍...

fields.name: Agilan Sampath
fields.comment:
The wedding reception hall was absolutely stunning, with elegant interiors and excellent arrangements that made the celebration truly memorable.
The beautiful ambiance and excellent service made the event even more joyful and grand.

I highly recommend this reception hall for anyone planning a wedding or special event.

fields.name: Mohanraj Devarajan
fields.comment: Located few kms away from Nelson manikam road., Mandapam has three floored constructed. fields.comment: RECENTLY WENT FOR COUSIN MARRIAGE WELL MAINTAINED SEATING CAPACITY OF 1000 AND DINING CAPACITY OF  300. PARKING FOR CAR AROUND 20 FOR TWO WHEELER ITS 50.

better requested customers will plan for buffet dinners will dine up to 90.

fields.comment:

fields.comment: Very affordable price and great ambience. Really supportive and friendly approach by mahal owner. Fully satisfied with the choice of booking this place. Very clean and neat.

fields.name: Durai Arasan
fields.comment:
Mahal is a great venue for functions and celebrations. The hall is spacious, clean, and well maintained. Seating arrangements were comfortable, and the overall ambience was pleasant. Owner & Staff were supportive and managed the event smoothly

Spacious hall with good ambience. Suitable for family functions. Overall a satisfactory experience

fields.name: Kss Narayanan
fields.comment: The Bhavan is situated in Gopalapuram, a suburb of Chennai.  Suitable for conducting marriages, and functions.  Every year, Krishna Jayanthi celebrations are conducted here in a grand manner.  20 to 25 animated moving dolls depicting Krishna Leela and stories from Ramayana are installed inside the hall, with sound and light decoration in the background.  Little Krishna in a cradle with all decorations is a  sight to watch.  An exquisite exhibition worth visiting, along with children.

Parking :
One side they left ofr the hikes and the other side is for the cars. But the staff there will allow maximum 7-8 cars and others have to put their cars at some other place. This place can hold a good amount fo 2 wheelers.
Hall :

Everything else:
Depends on who choose for your catering and what design you choose.. This is relatively spacious and a very good hall to choose.

fields.name: Michael Duong
fields.comment: Went here for a friend's Sangeet (kind of like a wedding reception with dancing). The venue was lovely and beautifully decorated. The first floor was the actual venue, the second floor was used as a dining hall, and the third floor had hotel style rooms. Overall it was an amazing experience

fields.name: Thiyagarajan N
fields.comment: Big hall and dining space is 1 story above and on the second story snacks, desserts are served. Centrally located. Negative point is very limited car parking.

fields.comment: Well furnishin anfd good survices

fields.name: Imtiaz Ahmed

fields.name: H A
fields.comment: Performed Marriage receiption . Well maintained  Hall with fine dining facility . Fully air-condioned . Excellent food . Well managed also. Catering service was very good.  when compare to the quality and number of items they are providing during catering service. Thanks to the Management and staff of roze mahal, Chennai for the support they have extended.

fields.name: Chandrasekar J
fields.comment: I attended a marriage function here. The hall was excellent lookwise and ambience wise too. The dining hall was good too. I would recommend it for a function.

fields.name: Praveena Puttum
fields.comment: The hall is very spacious, with a large dining area that can comfortably accommodate guests during events. It offers ample car and bike parking space, which is a major advantage for functions with bigger crowds. A lift facility is available, and rooms are also provided for guest convenience. However, the property is quite old and not very well maintained at present. With proper renovation and regular upkeep, it has great potential to become one of the most popular wedding halls. The only drawback is that the location is slightly difficult to find for first-time visitors.

fields.name: Balaji Murugesan
fields.comment: Very spacious hall, most suitable for family functions. Stage is very large. Superb interior. Excellent and spacious car parking. Balcony is available to accommodate more people. Rooms are available to stay in hall. Dining is very spacious. Major concern wash room is not good. Another major drawback location. Far away from city. Air conditioning is good. Much suitable for very large crowd.

fields.name: Mahesh Prabhakaran
fields.comment: Located amongst factories and godowns in the area this wedding hall has a huge space and is capable to manage large gatherings with a parking space for 50 cars and 100+ bike (approx), maybe more. You can literally have a 1000 people gather here and manage the crowd easily! This place is also very connected to Outer Ring Road (in mins) which makes travelling in and out easier than ever. Note: All figures I mentioned here are approx and based on what I saw real time, please reach out to the hall owners for actual facts and numbers.

fields.name: Nandhini Veerappan
fields.comment: Visited this wedding mahal for a friends wedding. This is a place for grand weddings which can accommodate around 1000 guests. Has a large car parking space outside the mahal. The air conditioning was good as well.

fields.name: Ramani Ramamoorthy
fields.comment: Very big marriage hall with huge parking area for more than hundred cars. Big dining hall and space outside for buffet. The Dias also was huge and could accommodate fifty people.

fields.name: Deepak Hari
fields.comment: Excellent place for small gathering, located near kasi theatre. Fully airconditioning and interiors are excellent. Stilt + 2 floors. Stilt floor is for parking, first floor is dining and second floor is party hall. Party hall has accommodation of 50 members. Dining hall can accommodate 30 members. Bike parking can be done up to 20. Lift provision is also available. DG backup is available.

fields.name: Raja Kumaran
fields.comment:
Looking good & Rich look at everything... Windows work designing work wood works & floor works & table chairs & falls sealing & had wash basin toilet & steps . Emergency kit fixed for use... lift facilities

Neat & Clean

fields.name: Jaya lakshmi
fields.comment:
An excellent venue for small gatherings, conveniently located near Kasi Theatre. The property is fully air-conditioned and features modern interiors with a Stilt + 2 floor structure.

Stilt Floor – Dedicated parking area with space for up to 20 two-wheelers.

First Floor – Well-designed dining hall that can accommodate up to 30 guests.

Second Floor – Spacious party hall with a seating capacity of up to 50 guests.

Additional amenities include lift access for ease of movement and DG backup to ensure uninterrupted power supply.

fields.name: Kaviya S
fields.comment: Good hall with great ambiance and enough space for dining. Air conditioning was perfect, budget friendly can accommodate 180+ . Neat dining and food we arranged in catering which is recommended by them itself was awesome and they delivered and served food neatly.

fields.name: Vinoth Kumar
fields.comment: The hall is very well maintained and clean. Dining area was comfortable, and the parking space was sufficient for our guests. Management took care of every small detail. Overall, a great experience.

fields.name: Periasamy S
fields.comment: Excellent place for Midle income group family functions. Very nice parking area.

fields.name: Archanaa Raghavan
fields.comment: Spacious AC hall that can seat around 500. Hall includes a big balcony from where one can enjoy comfortable view of the occasion. Free Parking available. The place is well connected

fields.name: senthilkumar Thiagarajan
fields.comment: Good place to host small functions with less than 500 guests,located in main road easily accessible by kattupakkam metro (in fact metro entrance is next door to the mahal)

fields.name: S m
fields.comment: Nice halll fully Ac car parking available

fields.name: Hermann Jacob

Perfect hall for wedding receptions and other gatherings. My wedding happened here and we had almost 1600 numbers visiting, and this place easily accommodated it, since it has a huge a/c hall, large dining area, well maintained restrooms and other amenities with ample car parking.

Apart from complimentary rooms for bride and groom, there are rooms available for just rs 2000/day. Room are good as well.

For the cost, this place is the best, compared to the other halls in Chennai.

fields.name: Arul Prabahar
fields.comment: The convention hall managed by CSI christian community. Ample parking space is available.

fields.name: JohnVictor ArunKumar
fields.comment: Good place for weddings. Excellent parking space. The dining hall and the reception halls are air conditioned and large halls with atleast 3000 capacity. Less lifts to handle big crowds, the rest rooms are not very clean to be managed better.

fields.name: Sunil Raj Philip Achen
fields.comment: This is a much spacious place, which is fully airconditioned, for wedding receptions and public meeting. This is owned by the Madras Diocese of the Church of South India and this kept as a serene place. Parking area connected with centre is enormous in this heart of the city.

fields.name: Rajagopalan S
fields.comment: The place is big and can accommodate substantial amount of people. Excellent parking for four and two wheelers. One of the few places in the city with good amount of parking. The dining hall is huge which can host considerable number of guests. The main hall and podium are big. Chairs can be placed on the sides as well. The place for wedding Oonjal is cute and nice. The toilets are neat and clean. The air conditioning all across is good. Podium is quite big.

fields.name: Gayathri shri Kashyap
fields.comment: The mandapam has good location and has ample parking space.The dinning which is in the ground floor has a capacity of 250 people. The mandapam is in the first floor and has a capacity of 1000 people. It is air conditioned. There is a separate stage for reception.

fields.name: Anabayan T A
fields.comment: Big Mandapam in very heart of the city-near Kodambakkam Rly stn. Neat and clean. Not that much decorative

fields.name: Ram Viswanathan
fields.comment:
Owned by actor Rajinikant, Raghavendra Mandapam is one of the  popular marriage halls in Chennai.  Strategically located, Mandapam is air cooled, spacious with ample car parking.

Given the brand, space and locality, it is bound be a costly place to rent and would require plenty of advance notice to get the desired slot.

fields.name: Praveen Kathir
fields.comment: The space is adequate. Stage OK is a great hall in the city.

fields.name: subhadra Krishnamachari

fields.name: Prasanna Ajay
fields.comment:
We celebrated our son's Ayush Homam at Miththam, ECR, on January 02, 2026 and it was an absolutely fantastic experience. The venue itself is beautiful, with an amazing ambiance that perfectly suited the traditional significance of the event.

A huge special thanks to Ashwin, who was our main point of contact. He was incredibly supportive throughout the entire process-from the initial planning stages to late-night meetings to finalize ideas. His dedication made the coordination seamless. Additionally, the decoration team did a stellar job; they executed the theme perfectly according to the plans we discussed.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a serene and well-managed event space !!

fields.name: Mugunthan Chakrapani
fields.comment: This place is exactly behind tlhe Nithya Kalyana Perumal temple in Thiruvidanthai. To reach this place you have to get in to the temple arch on the OMR. From the main road it will be around 1 km. Let us get in to the place details. This place is built on the traditional method, which attracts most of the people. Marriage within close relatives and friends can happen here. Maximum 75 people can be accommodated in this place to view the marriage happenings. One side you have the stage and people can view the marriage from 3 sides. Big air coolers arranged in all the 4 corners. It was not suffocating as it was 6 to 7 am muhutham in sep month, but not sure about the rooms. Not sure how it will be during the summer season. In the center, you have open terrace with glass covered and this area is filled with water and flower floating on it. Really nice arrangements and worth to host a memorable life time functions here. Rooms are available in the first and second floors with Lift facility available. Car parking is available with ample amount of space just opposite to this place. Dining hall is in different place, which is 200 meters away towards the Perumal temple . Battery car is available to take you to the dinning hall. I m not sure about the rate to host the functions in this place, but overall I feel it is good place to host small marriage functions. People coming from north madras should start early to reach this place.

fields.name: R viswanathan
fields.comment:
Attended a marriage event today at Miththam, located near Nithyakalyana Perumal Temple (off ECR). Though it's over 30 km from central Chennai, the venue offers a refreshing and peaceful setting.

The place is traditional and surrounded by greenery, with a calm, old-world charm. Guests can even view the event from the first floor, adding to the experience.

Tea, coffee, and juice were served at the venue, while breakfast and lunch were arranged in a separate dining area, just a short walk away. An electric vehicle is also available to shuttle guests between the two spots.

Parking is hassle-free thanks to the open surroundings. Overall, a lovely venue for weddings and small functions, if you don't mind the distance. Since I am based in proper Chennai, I had to take uber rental for six hours and paid Rs 2500, which I feel could have sent for a better purpose if the venue had been within the city.

fields.name: RAMESH S
fields.comment:
We had our daughter’s wedding at Miththam, and choosing this venue was truly a heartfelt decision. The place instantly reminded me of my grandfather’s house — traditional, serene, and filled with warmth. It is a very quiet location with ample parking space and a wonderful, pleasant atmosphere that perfectly suited a family wedding.

Our point of contact, Mr. Ajith, was exceptionally helpful and supportive. Whenever we reached out to him, he patiently clarified all our doubts and guided us through every arrangement, both before and after the event. His coordination made the entire process smooth and stress-free.

Mr. Arun was equally supportive and guided us throughout the event with great care and professionalism.

I must specially mention the entire Miththam team — they were cooperative, kind, and attentive at every step. Their dedication made our celebration seamless and joyful.

Thank you to the Miththam team for making our daughter’s wedding a beautiful and memorable occasion that we will always cherish. 🙏✨

fields.name: JAGANRAJA APPADURAI
fields.comment:
Wonderful place for small beautiful weddings, meetings and celebrations. Nice property, well maintained and perfectly located.

Recently we had a chance to attend our friend's wedding function here @ Miththam, Good place, nice architecture with green trees and a natural pond nearby.

Regular maintenance and a better road will make this property a top choice for our functions and gatherings for years to come..

fields.name: Suresh Narayanan
fields.comment:
We had the absolute pleasure of hosting our daughter’s three-day wedding celebration at Sree Varaaham, Koyambedu, and it was truly an exceptional experience.

The venue was impeccably clean, beautifully maintained, and perfectly suited for a grand celebration. The entire team worked tirelessly across all three days to ensure everything ran smoothly for our family and guests.

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Sathiamoorthy, the Venue Manager, who partnered with us for over 12 months leading up to the wedding, coordinating every detail with dedication and patience. Special appreciation to the owner, Mr. Ravi Kumar, who personally met with us and even attended the wedding to ensure everything was executed flawlessly. That level of care and hospitality truly sets this venue apart.

Outstanding service, warm hospitality, and a genuine five-star experience from start to finish.

Highly recommend Sree Varaaham to anyone looking for a memorable and stress-free wedding venue in Chennai.

fields.name: s Ashokkumar
fields.comment:
Sree Vaaraham Hall is a highly recommended, air-conditioned wedding venue located in Koyambedu, praised for its excellent accessibility and thoughtful amenities across multiple floors.
🗺️ Location & Access
Prime Location: Situated right on the main road in Koyambedu, eliminating the difficulty of finding it, especially for out-of-town guests.
Convenience: Easily accessible; the reviewer noted a quick 10-minute drive from JP Hotel.
🅿️ Ground Floor & Entrance Amenities
Parking: Covered parking lot is available to the left-hand side at the back upon entering the gate (capacity is unknown).
Grand Entrance: The main entrance features a welcoming atmosphere:
A waterfall infinity wall designed to relax the mind.
A huge Ganesha Idol.
A display of dolls resembling a traditional 'Gollu' setup.
Vertical Access: Guests have the option of using a spiral staircase or a lift to access the first and second floors.
Guest Restrooms: Conveniently located at the ground level near the lift.
👰 First Floor: Wedding Hall & Pre-Function Area
Hallway/Lounge: A long passage provides a functional space for guests:
An area for standing, socializing, and having coffee (if counters are set up).
Space for setting up activities like a Mehendi artist's table.
Features a window overlooking the flyover, offering views of Chennai.
Ritual Area: The 'Unjal' (Swing) for the couple's rituals was placed in this hallway/lounge area.
Wedding Hall: Spacious and well-lit.
Natural Light: Abundant natural light enters through the numerous windows, reducing the need for artificial lighting.
Stage: Gigantic, located to the right side upon entering, offering ample space for both the bride's and groom's sides.
Seating: Flexible arrangement options for the host.
Musician Area: A small, dedicated stage in the back corner for the musician/orchestra.
Changing Room (The Suite): Described as being reminiscent of a hotel room with:
Decent size, allowing multiple people to change simultaneously.
A bed for resting.
An attached bathroom.
🍽️ Second Floor: Dining Hall
Spacious Dining: The hall can accommodate many guests at once without feeling overcrowded due to efficient row arrangement.
Comfort: Bright and AC-equipped, ensuring a comfortable temperature while guests enjoy their meal.
Hygiene Feature: A thoughtful amenity is the presence of a paper towel dispenser near the hand washing sink, allowing guests to dry their hands without using a handkerchief.
✨ Additional Potential Feature
Terrace: The reviewer believes the hall also has a terrace for hosting functions at that level.

fields.name: Anbu
fields.comment: I had such a fantastic time at Sree Varaaham Hall! ✨ The atmosphere was wonderful, and everything was perfectly organized. I highly recommend this venue for any event! 💖 The staff was incredibly helpful and made my experience truly memorable. Can't wait to visit again! 😊

fields.name: Prathima Joishy
fields.comment:
Sree Vaaraham Hall is an AC wedding hall located in Koyambedu.  The location is perfect because it is right on the main road, and one will not have to go in circles trying to find the place - especially if you are visiting from out of town.  It took us just 10 minutes from JP Hotel where many guests and us were staying.

Upon entering the gate, you can find the covered parking lot to the left hand side at the back.  I am unsure how many cars can be parked as I did not go that side.  Once you enter the main door, you can find a beautiful infinity wall of waterfall to relax your mind.  There is a huge Ganesha Idol to welcome you to the hall. You can also find a display of dolls to the right or the Ganesha Idol that reminded me of the figurines kept during 'Gollu' The guest has the option of taking the spiral staircase or the lift to the first and second floors.

Upon entering the first floor, you can find a long passage way where guests can stand and talk, have a coffee or two in case some counters have been set up, keep a table or two for the mehendi artist to sit or one can simply stand at the window and enjoy the sights of beautiful Chennai as this hall looks over the flyover. This is the area where the 'Unjal' or Swing was kept for the couple to sit while certain rituals were performed.

To the right side, you can find the spacious and well lit wedding hall. The stage is located to the right hand side once you enter.  Due to the number of windows, natural light can fall through and the lights are not really needed.

I must say this is such a beautiful wedding hall.  The stage is gigantic and both the bride and groom's side have adequate space in their respective places.  The changing room reminded me of a hotel room. It was of a decent size and many people could change at once, there was a bed in case anyone wanted to take rest during the function.  There was an attached bathroom too.

The seating arrangement can be done in anyway the host chooses.  In the corner at the back, there is a small stage where the musician and/or orchestra can assemble to play their hearts away during the function.

Moving to the 2nd Floor, you will find the dining hall that could accomodate many guests at once, but one would not find it overcrowded because of the way the rows were arranged.  Just like the wedding hall, the dining hall is bright and with AC so you don't have to feel the heat while eating the delicious lunch!

There is a sink to wash your hands and what I really liked was the paper towel dispenser kept near by so people could wipe their hands instead of using their own handkerchief.

I believe this hall also has a terrace in case you want to host a function at that level.

The bathrooms for the guests are located at ground level near the lift.

Sree Vaaraham Hall is a nice place to host your special functions and make it more memorable!

fields.name: Kesava Perumal
fields.comment:
Overall excellent. Roof top facilities are amazing, enjoying the event with vadaplani and Koyambedu look out.Murtha mandapam arrangements are good with all Pooja items. Kitchen and Dining are very hygenic. I appreciate administrative team coordiate with us from the time of booking till end of the events. I really appreciate Sree Varaaham Hall Management and all other staff members coordination for my daughters marriage to celebrate this event in a joyful and impressive way.
Thanks & Regards
Prabu

Starting from Mr Seemon, Mr Selvam, Mr Jagan, Mr Ruben, Mr. Balaji etc , all were very nice and ensured everything was in place as discussed and agreed. There has been no follow-up for any thing.  Pushpa catering has done a fabulous job. The food was very tasty and they have taken care of our guests very well. All in all an amazing venue to have the wedding function. fields.name: Sridhar Velu
fields.comment: The ambience and location of this marriage hall is very good. The workers and managers are very friendly and always available to help. They take care very well, explanation of the charges, walk thru of the location and details they share while settlement is clear and transparent. Has lot of car parking, had a very peaceful time for the entire duration of marriage and everyone was appreciating on the cleanliness, the number of rooms available and maintenance of the same is very good. We all enjoyed the entire duration

fields.name: Vasuchi Vasudevan
fields.comment: True to its name, Sri Devi Palace Marriage Hall truly feels like a palace! The ambience, lighting, chandeliers, and cleanliness are top-notch — far better than many halls in Chennai city. Excellent value for money! The hall easily fits 800+ guests, and the ample parking opposite the venue is a huge bonus. Service is outstanding — Mr. Nehru (Manager) and his team are super courteous, professional, and always ready to help. Rooms are spacious with clean, well-kept washrooms. The dining area on the same floor is so convenient, and the air conditioning works perfectly — a must for Chennai! The only small suggestion would be to add a few more washrooms for visitors. Overall, a beautiful, well-managed venue that offers elegance, comfort, and great service — highly recommended for weddings and big functions!

fields.name: Bharat K.V.
fields.comment:
Had the chance to attend my cousin’s wedding at AVM Rajeshwari Kalyana Mandapam, and what a beautiful experience it was! The mandapam is grandly designed, with spacious halls, an equally large dining area, and huge, comfortable rooms — perfect for hosting a big, traditional celebration.

But what truly made my day was stumbling upon a collection of vintage Tamizh cinema posters inside the premises. As a Tamizh cinema buff, it felt like walking through a piece of film history.  Don’t miss checking them out if you ever visit — such a nostalgic trip down memory lane!

Also, the location is great and well-connected, making it easy for guests. Whether you’re there for a wedding or just passing by, take a moment to soak in the charm — this place is more than just a mandapam; it’s a slice of cultural heritage.

fields.name: Triangle Services Photography
fields.comment: We had the pleasure of covering a wedding at this gorgeous venue &  it was an absolute dream for photography , The hall is not only spacious and well-organized but also radiates elegance with its traditional yet classy architecture ,One of the standout features for us was the beautiful pathway leading to the main entrance lined with greenery and warm lights, it added a magical touch to the couple portraits and candid moments ,The mandap setup, ambient lighting, and overall decor offered a perfect blend of charm and comfort

fields.name: Shekar Chandrasekaran
fields.comment:
The Perfect Wedding Venue – Where Excellence Meets Heart

After visiting over 35 venues across Chennai, ECR, and Mahabalipuram – including several five-star hotels and top-rated properties – I knew from the very first moment I stepped onto the AMRK Banquet Hall property at RK Convention Center, Neelankarai, that this was where my daughter's wedding would be. Sometimes you just know.

AMRK breaks away from the typical marriage hall mold. Set on a sprawling piece of land, it offers a sense of space and serenity that's rare to find – no feeling of being hemmed in by concrete jungles here.

The hall itself is beautifully designed with thoughtful touches throughout. The main event area sits adjacent to the dining space, connected by huge glass windows that keep guests engaged with the celebrations even while they dine. The stage is generously large, offering endless possibilities for decoration limited only by your imagination. Natural light floods the hall beautifully, complemented by excellent indoor lighting that creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. The spacious outdoor portico is perfect for conducting traditional Hindu wedding rituals with ease and grace.

What truly impressed me – and many of my guests – was the impeccable maintenance of the property. People kept asking how they manage to keep everything, including the public restrooms, at five-star hotel standards. It's a rare level of care and attention to detail.

The staff were extraordinary. Available literally 24 hours a day, I never once saw a frown or hint of frustration on anyone's face. But what made the biggest difference was their attitude: there was never a "no." Even when my requests were a bit out of the ordinary, their response was always, "Let us see how we can make that happen for you" – and they delivered every single time.

Special mention and heartfelt thanks to Mr. Rajasekar, Fatima Madam, Balaji, and the incredible cleaning crew who worked tirelessly to keep everything pristine.

The pricing is competitive with top properties in Chennai, and there are excellent accommodation options nearby for out-of-town guests at reasonable rates – a real bonus for wedding planning.

If you're looking for a wedding venue in Chennai, AMRK Banquet Hall is truly a no-brainer. It's where exceptional facilities meet genuine hospitality and heart. Our daughter's wedding was everything we dreamed of, and this venue played a huge part in making it unforgettable.

Cannot recommend highly enough!

Visited this Government Marriage Hall located right opposite to Thiru Vi Ka Nagar Bus Stand, and I must say, the location is spot-on! 🚏 Easy to reach by any mode of transport, and the parking space 🅿️ is quite large — a big plus for city events. Bookings are done online 💻, and the rental cost is very reasonable considering it’s a government-managed facility.

The hall is spacious, perfect for medium to large gatherings, with the main hall on the 2nd floor and the dining area on the 1st floor. There’s a single lift, which helps but could be more efficient during crowded functions.

However, the maintenance needs improvement 🧹 — the hall had visible stains, the lift button had to be pressed hard to respond, and during one of the functions, there was a power cut ⚡ for a few minutes. Not sure if there’s a generator backup, as it didn’t seem to kick in immediately.

Overall, it’s a budget-friendly and well-located hall, but with better upkeep and maintenance, it could easily become one of the top choices in the area for family events and weddings 💒✨
