fields.name: Crasu Crason
fields.comment:
The Jeevan Jyothi Mahal, located right on the main road, is an excellent venue for events of all kinds. The compound is spacious and well-maintained, featuring a beautiful church and three halls that cater to different budgets, making it suitable for both small gatherings and larger functions.

One of the standout features is the parking area – it’s massive and completely free, which is a huge relief in the city. Accessibility is another big plus; the venue is well-connected and easy to reach from all parts of the city. Overall, whether you’re planning a wedding, a party, or any event, The Jeevan Jyothi Mahal is a convenient, affordable, and well-equipped choice.

fields.name: Rtn Arul Prakasam T
fields.comment: Jeevan Jothi Mahal in Manapakkam is an exceptional choice for hosting family weddings, especially when considering the comfort of elderly relatives. The venue stands out for its thoughtful accessibility features, including dedicated wheelchair-accessible parking and a smooth entrance ramp, making it incredibly inclusive. Located conveniently near MIOT Hospital and DLF Cyber City, it is easy for guests traveling from different parts of Chennai to find. The hall itself is spacious and well-maintained, providing a warm atmosphere for large gatherings. Having landmarks like Dr. MGR Home nearby adds a sense of community. The staff is polite and ensures everything runs smoothly. For families seeking a stress-free experience where everyone feels accommodated, this venue is a top-tier recommendation. It truly bridges the gap between modern convenience and traditional hospitality.

fields.name: Alex Beascoechea
fields.comment: It is incredible they are allowed to disturb the whole neighbourhood - starting by the guests in the Feathers Hotel across the street- projecting their celebrations into public the public space. Right now with what sounds like some tribale danese music with drums.... Here everything is sacrificed for the economic benefit of some individual (the owner of this joint) and the rest have to suffer.

fields.name: செல்வம் சுப்பிரமணியம்
fields.comment:
It's a very big wedding hall.
Around 500 peoples can sit in a main hall.
Around 400 peoples can sit for dining.
Interior decoration is very nice and AC is there
More than 100 cars can be parked. Inside.
The hall is situated in main road itself, so it can be easily accessible.
This wedding hall is for rich peoples.

fields.name: Anubis_ YT
fields.comment:
My matrimonial celebration at this estimable hall was nothing short of resplendent—a veritable confluence of gastronomic opulence and aesthetic grandeur. The catering was, in a word, sublime. Each dish presented itself as an edible sonnet, with a cornucopia of choices so abundant and meticulously curated that it bordered on the encyclopedic. From ambrosial appetizers to the epiphanic desserts, every morsel was a testament to culinary erudition and epicurean artistry.

The decoration was an exquisite tableau of color and craftsmanship, evoking the grandeur of a baroque opera while retaining an ineffable sense of intimacy. The floral arrangements were positively seraphic; the interplay of light and fabric created an atmosphere so incandescently enchanting that it seemed to suspend time itself.

In sum, this marriage hall exemplifies the very apotheosis of refinement—a sanctuary where elegance converses fluently with comfort and where every detail, however minute, bespeaks a devotion to perfection. It is not merely a venue, but a memory immortalized in chandeliers, fragrance, and flavor.

fields.name: Mohan Kumar
fields.comment: Is a nice Mahul for conducting various functions like marriage get together party and excetra it's has a carpeting facilities and bike parking facilities and the hall is located in the first floor and dining hall is located in the the second floor has a lift facilities too and capacity 500 to 600 people dining hall capacity 100 to 200 overall decent marriage hall.

fields.name: Balaji Ravikumar
fields.comment: One of the biggest halls in the locality. They have so many rooms all well furnished and maintained. Good parking facility, located at the GNT road. Kitchen is very spacious and comfortable. Big AC dining. The AC cooling is really awesome throughout the reception hall. Has a big hall capacity and friendly staff. Highly recommend this place!

fields.name: Rachel
fields.comment: Very worst Mahal I've ever seen in my life before. No proper maintaining, restrooms are so ugly and surrounding places are so much wastages and junk.

fields.name: kuppuswamy srinivasan
fields.comment: This is located at Redhill service road of chemnai to nelloor highway. It has spacious marriage hall with plenty of rooms and spacious covered car park.

fields.name: Madhana Gopal
fields.comment: really liked this wedding hall! It's so neatly kept and well-maintained. The air conditioning was great too, making everything comfortable.

fields.name: devaraj dhanakotti
fields.comment: Underground parking for 2 wheelers, Wallet parking for Cars, Basement kitchen, 1st floor function hall with AC, 2nd floor dining with AC, 3rd floor rooms with AC. 1st hall is sufficient for 200~250 people sitting comfortably with sufficient space for entry and exit of seat rows provided. AC was effective even with a lot of people. Large Stage and false ceilings are designed for default decoration and lightings. The steps are wider and spacious to walk as 3 together side by side. 2nd floor dining area can occupy 100~150 people at a time. Hand washing and rest rooms are inbuilt in 2nd floor only. 1 lift is available which can accommodate 5 people at a time.

fields.name: Santosh Kumar
fields.comment: Very good mandapa. Hospitality was very good. Clean & neat. 12 Rooms are very comfortable to stay. Air conditioning was very good. We can suggest en sesha mahal, Royapettah for friends and Relatives.

fields.name: Suresh Abar
fields.comment:
Electricity units reading is completely terrible
So pls see all electric meters n check
Otherwise they will make it 3times more electricity charges

fields.name: Venkatasubramaniam R
fields.comment: Compact for 200 guests, right on Peter's Riad, Royaoettah near New College. Limited parking in the building, which is on the busy road facing flyover. So vallet parking available. Feast is on the second floor. Ac facility available. Ideal for small events like Reception, Birth Day, etc.

fields.name: Mohammed ashif
fields.comment: This venue in Royapuram is a fantastic find for anyone planning a wedding or a large celebration. It strikes that perfect balance of being in a prime, accessible location while offering enough room so guests never feel cramped. The layout is thoughtfully designed with dedicated spaces for dining as well as separate areas for men and women, ensuring everyone feels comfortable and at ease. Plus, the ample car parking—a rare luxury in such a busy part of the city—takes a huge weight off the hosts' shoulders. It truly feels like a space that values both convenience and hospitality, making it a worthwhile choice for your special day.

fields.name: Syed Ali A N J (Jumaana Syed Ali)
fields.comment: A beautiful and spacious mahal, ideal for hosting large weddings. It features a large hall on the ground floor, along with a dedicated ladies’ hall on the first floor. For dining, ladies can dine on the first floor, while men have a separate dining area on the second floor. Basement parking is available; however, since the mahal is located on the main road, parking may be challenging if the basement becomes full.

fields.name: Rajesh Rajendran
fields.comment: Best place. . Recommended for big functions . . Neat and clean surroundings. .

fields.name: Mujubur Rahman
fields.comment:
I have attended my relative nikkah function on Ramjan Mahal. Ample space for the entrance. Large reception hall.  In the middle they have a lot of pillars, that are minus. The food court was also big on the second floor.
They used a mic in the function that was not good. Every time they have the same fault. It's not working properly. Parking space ok.

fields.name: Muhammad Asif
fields.comment: One of the top notch marriage function halls in Chennai. Recommended for sure❤️❤️

fields.name: Chembu Mohan Karthik
fields.comment: It is small hall in an narrow road, but good thing is that it got parking underground. It has good view from road and you just have to search for the Raj theater which just next to it. Nice place for small function and marriage who has less number of family member in the list. Thank you

fields.name: Jack G
fields.comment: No proper parking facilities. Very difficult to park the bikes and take out. Location is main road so problem in finding the marriage hall. Inside hall wall looks old, I think they didn’t painted very long time. Dinning area somewhat ok.

fields.name: Rini Prabha
fields.comment:
This Mahal is well suitable for function with a fine dining area.

I personally felt it is too small for larger events.

fields.name: Sharath Kumar Venugopal
fields.comment: Really good hall. The top Marriage hall is AC and bottom is for dining. No lift service available. Decent can hold 400 seating and 600 floating.

fields.name: Naresh Kani
fields.comment:
Last Sunday My Brother Marriage Function wAs held in this mahal Very nice place..
Located near by Saidapet busstand, station and metro. We also stay one night here..

fields.name: Raju Sreenivasan
fields.comment: Great ambience. Beautiful hall. Spacious dining area. Wallet parking was available. It is very close to the main road as well. It can easily accommodate 500 to 750 people

fields.name: sowmya smartha
fields.comment: Amazing experience with Shree Devi Mahal. The owner Vignesh , a gentleman, very understanding , polite and professional.  So much support with anything you ask. You ask something and it’ll be there in front of you in less than 5 minutes. Their supervisor/ support manager Dhana , man never seen a person so fresh and smiling all the time . Never once you see anyone at the venue frown or irritated. Commendable cleanliness. Their kitchen was very very clean and the rooms and the restrooms were also very clean. Any spill at the venue will be cleaned within 5 mins. Such smooth experience. If you book them you will have one less thing to worry about in your wedding.

fields.name: Ravikrishnan Natarajan
fields.comment: A great marriage hall built to host 500 attendees in comfort (fully air conditioned), with a matching dining hall and spacious rooms for the families of bride and groom, though lack of openable windows is a big disappointment. Also, the stench from the drainage especially in the dining space is a real spoiler. Unlayer the grand facade and you have a basic hall that lacks hygiene.

fields.name: Iyengar Ramakrishnan
fields.comment:
Rooms were clean and staff was extremely helpful.

Two lifts which provide ease of access.

Great place to hold many events.

fields.name: Tamilselvan Rajavel
fields.comment: Well spacious hall. Situated in main road near camproad signal. Parking available for two wheeler and four wheeler. Clean and well maintained place. A/C hall. Stay rooms are available. The street will be more congested in working days. Costly hall.

fields.name: Manoj M
fields.comment: Overall it has 1 floor, Dining will happen in the ground floor and the main party hall in the first floor. It can accommodate upto 75 people with air conditioned facility and this hall is suitable for small functions with seating capacity of upto 75 people. No car parking facility is available that's the drawback. Overall it's a mediocre party hall. I don't know the pricing and other stuffs but if I came to know such things I will update here.

fields.name: Thiagarajan TD
fields.comment: Very compact hall with approx seating capacity for 250-300 pax. Parking in the adjacent area. Hall bang on East Tambaram - Velachery road. People coming from Velachery take the main road via Pallikaranai. Those from Tambaram, straight on to Tambaram Velachery Road.

fields.name: Stidson Santhosh kumar
fields.comment: I had a wonderful experience at *Bhavani Hall* during our recent function. The hall was well-maintained and perfectly suited for the occasion. Special thanks to the *Manager* for the excellent cooperation and understanding of our needs. He not only ensured smooth arrangements but also referred a great *decoration and makeup team*, which made the event even more special. Truly appreciate the support and professionalism. Highly recommended!

fields.name: savitha manoharan
fields.comment: They got good parking space and hall may look small from outside but it got spacious inside. Good place for bday parties and small events

fields.name: Rubadevan Vas
fields.comment:
Correct match for party/functions for 250 to  300 headcount. 100 people can sit comfortably on the ground floor with suiting dining hall.
PARKING 2/4 wheeler is the an ISSUE. No separate parking area is available. Need park on the main road...

fields.name: Sundar S
fields.comment:
I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for the excellent service and facilities provided during our Nephew marriage event. Our experience was seamless, and we received numerous compliments from our guests.
Here are a few highlights that truly stood out:
•	Stunning Infrastructure & Ambience: The venue is beautifully designed, blending modern elegance with a welcoming atmosphere. The lighting and overall aesthetic provided the perfect backdrop for our celebrations.
•	Impressive Capacity: The hall is spacious and well-ventilated, comfortably accommodating all our guests without feeling crowded. The layout allowed for smooth movement throughout the event.
•	Top-notch Kitchen Facilities: The kitchen and dining area were impeccably clean and well-organized. It was clear that hygiene and efficiency are top priorities for your team.
•	Exceptional Support: Every staff member we interacted with was professional and attentive, ensuring that even the smallest details were handled with care.
Special Mention: Mr. Vinayagamurthy
A very special thanks goes to the manager, Mr. Vinayagamurthy. His leadership and support were instrumental in the success of our nephew marriage event. From the initial planning stages to the final execution, his proactive approach, calm demeanor, and "can-do" attitude took a huge weight off our shoulders. He is a true asset to Umadhiri Mahal.
Thank you once again for making our special day so memorable. We will certainly be recommending your venue to our friends and family.
Warm regards,
Sundaravadivelan Subramani

fields.name: Sarathvijay M
fields.comment:
We had a fantastic experience at Shri Umadri Mahal for our family wedding. A special thanks to the owner, the manager (Mr. Vinayaga Moorthy) and his dedicated team for their support & incredible hospitality. From the very beginning, he was exceptionally supportive, personally connecting us with top-tier catering and decor vendors to ensure everything was perfect.
The facility itself is spacious, features ample car parking and is very well-maintained. We truly appreciated a management team that handles the details so well, allowing us to relax and enjoy the wedding.

fields.name: Deva kumar
fields.comment:
Went for a book fair

Parking area is decent can hold up 25-30 cars and two wheelers
Hall was moderate size and will be very opt for weddings and gatherings

Separate reception area is available
Location is right on OMR service road and it's quite convenient

Lawn and landscaping was maintained lush green

Nice place overall

fields.name: Pavithra Suresh
fields.comment:
Huge spacious hall with 2 in built LD screens. Separate dining hall. Ample car parking space. Rooms are neatly maintained. The important point is that water can and bubble top dispensers are kept in the rooms for the needs of the bride and groom family.

The cleaning team maintains the hall from time to time. The A/c is effective.

fields.name: Saravana Babu Srinivasan
fields.comment: Excellent Experience.  We had our daughter's marriage in Shri Umadri Mahal last week.  Mr.Vinayaga Moorthy, Manager for this Mahal made sure that we had all required things in a smooth manner.  He is so polite and was accommodating all our requests for various things even in the last minute, co-operated with us in a cool manner and coordinated things so well that we did not have much hassles.  We were able to concentrate on other priority things because of his involvement. Our wedding went well because of his help and involvement from the time of booking the hall till we checked out of the marriage hall.  Special and Sincere Thanks to him and his team.  Mahal is well maintained, spacious, clean and neat looking.  Major advantage in this Mahal is: Both Dining and Hall are in the same floor,  Dining is just opposite to the main hall.  We strongly recommend this Mahal to families looking for Marriage Halls and for any big family functions, talk to Mr.Vinayagamoorthy, you will find him so cordial and he takes care of all functions as if it is his own family function.

fields.name: Leenus Martin
fields.comment: Attended a baby shower function at the mini hall located at the first floor. Steps are narrow. Dining tables were arranged inside the hall. Hall is enough for around 150 people maximum. A small dressing room is available inside the hall. Car parking is spacious. Can hold around 25 to 30 cars.

fields.name: Sree Sivakumar
fields.comment: It's a superb and neat place for celebrations for around 150 people but dinning space is too small and there is no bride and groom room and cot ..it has only 1 small room with sofa alone

fields.name: Kavitha Manohar
fields.comment: Best place to have marriage at an affordable price with rooms and service apartments. We really appreciate them for arranging proper parking for all the guests, who were all happy. All the rooms were clean and A/C was working well. The owner was very kind enough to call back even after the marriage for any concerns. Very supportive Manager, Mr.Raja singh and the Owner & staff. Happy that we conducted our son's marriage at SGR Mahal. We highly recommend this hall for Marriages and other functions

fields.name: Suganthy Ananth
fields.comment: On the main road. Big marriage hall. Fully airconditioned. Dining hall in the 1st floor. Car parking is available for limited cars. Rest is street parking only.

fields.name: Rajan Kalambur
fields.comment: Good function hall got two versions. Mini mahal for smaller function and bigger mahal for wedding reception kind of bigger functions. Air conditioned wedding hall with spacious parking on the main road.

fields.name: Aravindhan
fields.comment: My sister’s wedding was held at Perundevi Mandabam on Feb 19th(Reception) and 20th(Marraige) 2026, and it turned out to be a wonderful experience for our entire family. The hall is spacious, well-maintained, perfect for a grand celebration and affordable. The management and staff were very supportive and ensured everything went smoothly. As a brother, I’m truly grateful that the venue helped make her special day so memorable.

fields.name: subhikshamenggservices enginnering
fields.comment: My daughter's wedding was held at Perundevi Mandabam on Feb 19th(Reception) and 20th(Marraige) 2026, and it turned out to be a wonderful experience for our entire family. The hall is spacious, well-maintained, perfect for a grand celebration and affordable. The management and staff were very supportive and ensured everything went smoothly.

fields.name: Murali R
fields.comment:
Very well maintained with superb car parking... The inside of the Mandapam looks good and air conditioners are maintained well ...

Improve area - wheel chairs assistance for older people will help more also the management provide good support to everyone...

Keep up the good work to the admin and team

fields.name: padma sowjanya
fields.comment:
5 Star review !! Exceptional Venue for Our Tamil Celebration!

We recently rented this beautiful place to host and celebrate our family event, and it was nothing short of exceptional. The facilities were outstanding — spacious, clean, and perfectly equipped for a family event of any size. Every detail, from the setup to the amenities, was thoughtfully designed to make hosting effortless and enjoyable. The guests left with a good note and a positive experience.

What truly made the experience special were the wonderful owners. They were incredibly friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to ensure everything ran smoothly. Their care and attention to detail played a huge part in the success of our event.

We couldn’t have asked for a better venue or better hosts. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a warm, well-maintained, and welcoming space for family gatherings or cultural celebrations!

fields.name: Sathish Sundharamurthy
fields.comment: We had our known friend wedding here. The location was awesome. The lightings were beautiful. Mesmerizing location. Modern Mandapam in vallakottai and Sriperumbudur area. Love dthis place and the hospitality owners offered. Very accomodtive owners. Blue for money venue.

fields.name: Raja Kumaran
fields.comment:
Good Looking Function hall provided by St. Thomas church community.. it's not like as usual .. it's great and looking luxurious Hall setup. Interior and decor work was appreciatable . Fully Air conditioning Hall

Dining with capacity 140 members ( Ground Floor )

Welcome has place to provide stalls and counter. Parking spaces available. Easily located by new peoples.

Bus stop : Saidapet Court or Little Mount
Walkable distance from bus stand.

fields.name: Anbu Nesan
fields.comment:
The best convention hall which I have recently went for a function.
Very neat and spacious. Good parking facility. The best part is, it’s just opposite to chinnamalai church. The view is divine and awesome.

fields.name: thomas raj
fields.comment: Wonderful wedding hall in heart of city with  ample car park ,world famous St.thomas church where the Apostle Saint Thomas himself prayed here in cave and did miracles of spring on the hillock which still comes after 2000years.  The auditorium in 1st floor don't have lift which makes the elder and sick very difficult. The ground floor has big dining area with verandah to serve ice cream,coffee and fruits. If vacant it's given to all who are in need on a moderate rates.

fields.name: Sathiyanarayanan Mohan
fields.comment:
Spacious! Reachable by all modes of Local Transport!

One of the very few Community Hall for Serving Non-Vegetarian Banquet is allowed

Ample Parking Space! Near to Saidapet Bridge opposite to Vasanth & Co Signal. From Here reaching Guindy or Alandur Metro is easy!

Ambiance is so cool and Fresh! AC dining Hall! Clean hand wash section and Washrooms!

fields.name: Mr JW
fields.comment:
Good hall with good amenities 😁

Nice parking space

Neat and clean

Well maintained

Good place to conduct family functions and get together parties 🎉

fields.name: Venugopal KS
fields.comment: An old Wedding Hall in the Heart of Chennai city. Well maintained with a Hall capacity of more than 500 and spacious, Dining Hall in the Ground floor with Wash Room. Parking space for at least 25 Veh able. Reachable from any spot. Liked it. 😍

fields.name: Mandolin Saiganesh
fields.comment: Very nice ambience..Our Saiswarangal Band have had the pleasure of making the event of clients a memorable one at different occasions at this venue..

fields.name: Srivatsan Krishnamachari
fields.comment:
Located in T.Nagar old property could have bern maintained better.

Car parking is limited but these days they have valet service.

Dining hall is ok bestsuited for a guest count of 200 to 250.

fields.name: Nirmal Prakash
fields.comment: Went to Anantha Deepavali, each year it’s conducted in this Mandapam. Lot of happy faces and kids around this location, give a good pleasure.

fields.name: kailash baskar
fields.comment:
Spacious, with limited space for car parking, spacious dining hall.
Can accommodate 1000 people at a time easily.
Rooms were pretty small, ambiance and the locality of the building is top notch.
Suitable for wedding and other functions.
Can park the cars on the streets with no restrictions as well. Safe and calm surroundings.

fields.name: Ashwin Sundar
fields.comment:
Compact a 300-400 seater
Floating crowd could clearly manage. Very well maintained with good Air Conditioners. Amole house keeping was available

fields.name: Suresh Krishman
fields.comment:
Location is on a Very Very Busy highway. Hence both advantageous and disadvantageous.
Parking for cars limited
Hall suitable for around 150 people. Stage space just ok.
Dining hall good for around 200 guests at a time.
Though Lift facility is available, to reach the lift one has to climb a flight of steps (close to15). So not friendly to old people and people with special needs.. Function hall in first floor and dining in ground floor.

fields.name: Aryanand P
fields.comment: Excellent place for marriage l. Large hall and for dinning also big hall

fields.name: P.NALLAPERUMAL PILLAI
fields.comment: Nice Kalyana mandapam in Tambaram   Main road..AC hall having nice auditorium of medium sized. Capacity is 300 persons and dining is having 120 packs.

fields.name: Santhosh Nair
fields.comment:
One of the famous Marriage halls in and around Tambaram.
Though they lost a lot of area during road expansion, it still looks great
Located approx half a km from the famous hindu mission hospital, this hall can be located easily
Parking facilities are OK and convenient.
Though the marriage hall is wide, the dining area is bit suffocating when the crowd is more.

fields.name: Abdul Kader M
fields.comment:
I visited this place on 25-Jan-2026 for a wedding. The marriage hall is very spacious and has excellent seating arrangements with full air-conditioning. There is ample car parking available.
However, one drawback is that there are only three toilets(Gents) for the entire hall, which feels insufficient for such a large venue

fields.name: RAM KUMAR M
fields.comment: Luxury place. Very big area .fully air conditioned .neatly maintained and ample space for car parking

fields.name: Richardson Jeyapaul
fields.comment: Excellent for marriage and other large events. Hall is more grandeur than a 5 star hotel. Large space for food. Even the garden was huge

fields.name: Vijay Deepak
fields.comment:
Great place to be. Spacious but far from city,
Car parking is big.

fields.name: ABHIJITH S NAIR
fields.comment:
GPN Palace is a great place for weddings, receptions, and other events.

Location:
It is easy to reach and has enough parking space for guests.

Ambience:
The hall is spacious, clean, and beautifully designed. It suits both traditional and modern decorations.

Facilities:

The hall is fully air-conditioned and comfortable.

Seating can be arranged for both small and large events.

The stage is well-made, and the lighting is excellent.

Services:
They provide in-house catering with tasty vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. The staff is friendly and helpful, making the event smooth and enjoyable.

Cost:
The venue is reasonably priced for the quality and services they offer.

Overall:
GPN Palace is a great choice for hosting special events. Everything is well-organized, and the experience is worth the cost.

fields.name: Ajay Vignesh
fields.comment: This is a completely out of Chennai, though you have good roads from Anna Nagar,  tambaram. You need to travel for an hour to reach this place. This would be good for marriage and small reception crowd. Can accommodate around 800+ people. But you don't have sufficient bike or car parking.  Has a decent dinning space. Overall it's good for small crowded.

fields.name: செல்வம் சுப்பிரமணியம்
fields.comment:
Very spacious marriage and dining hall.
Clean and well maintained.
Parking will be a big problem in peak hours.

fields.name: renuka arjunan
fields.comment: Nice place to hold your big event. Only disadvantage is the distance .. otherwise great place for family occasions

fields.name: Nachiappan Sbm
fields.comment: Located on TH high road, Rajakadai area. This marriage hall both the floors are fully air conditioned, good interior design, spacious and well maintained. Bike parking is available at the back side of this place, not sure about car parking though. Lift facility is available here

fields.name: MANIKANDAN GAJENDRAKUMAR
fields.comment: As a caterer i am giving a review about this Mandabam. The Mandabam is very big, main hall we can make seats for 500 Members and Dining Hall we can make 250 members seating. Vessels more than enough, Manager is friendly, the Kitchen is good enough and there is a separate place for cutting the vegetables and even we can keep the foods in middle of kitchen and dinning so that the food wont get cool in direct AC. No parking Available, I am not sure whether they have any wallet parking or any separate place to park the vehicles. Ground Flour Main hall and first flour Dining Hall.

fields.name: emmy kriz
fields.comment: Very Good area for Sports.. it's like resort.. but the resort owner not allowing to cook the non vegetarian inside the campus...

fields.name: Sasidharan K P
fields.comment:
Very good ambience. Perfect place for a family lunch. Kids will enjoy a lot with many outdoor attractions like swing, water games, balloon shoot, trampoline etc. Cricket bowling machine available. Ample parking space, calm and serene place quite away from the main road.
Tasty vegetarian dishes served in earthen clay pots and banana leaves. Traditional meals, south Indian marriage meals available. Reasonable cost.

fields.name: Nisha Dinesh
fields.comment:
Visited this place for a birthday party 🎉🎊
So it's evening time,  place was absolutely beautiful with lights on and winter evening

They provide dance and music classes as parents were waiting to receive their kids from class
I guess there is cricket practice ground next to it.
The interiors of hotel looks ethnic with earthen pots 🍯for water and brick walls adds beauty to the place.
Regarding food we had North Indian Buffet  which was delicious with naan, kadai mushroom 🍄was awesome.
Had a great evening spent with nature🌲🍃🍂

fields.name: Eyokesh S
fields.comment: Held a small function in their mini hall and ordered food here. Food preparation and service was good. Eventhough varieties and options are limited, food was neither too spicy nor bland. Main hall is bigger in size and can easily accommodate 200+ guests, whereas mini hall can accommodate 70+ guests. Overall satisfied with the service and would recommend it for small to medium gatherings.

fields.name: Kasiraman Ramachandran
fields.comment: I joined this club with an annual membership mainly for using the swimming pool. The pool is  clean and maintained well. Maximum depth is 5 ft. Coaching sessions are organised based on number of interested candidates. The indoor badminton and table tennis facility can also be used with the membership. The vegetarian food restaurant offers good lunch buffet. A nice place.

fields.name: Ram Mehenthi
fields.comment: Nice and compact wedding or party hall. Good air-conditioned hall. Has a lift to the first floor for dining hall.

fields.name: Àrivazhagi Ma
fields.comment:
Hey can u c the space on the stage as well before the stage! Isn't it awesome! So many can stand as a family together, as well photographers have their space too. While the strength of the hall can hold so many at a time!

Also their dinning space with so many to serve and care about are really great.

A stage for musicians too high enough for all to sit and see, while still not disturbing anyone is also set well.

Car parking ...mmm. very much spacious indeed.

Good for a royal family to spend time with all their loved ones eeting together in one place.
A grand big party hall in and around from Thiruvattriyur till Washermanpet and Royapuram.

On my way back late night Chennai looked colourful, bright and calm not only in Anna Salai, also called as Mount Road.

Thanks to all and particularly God for showering His blessings to 1 &all 🙏

fields.name: krishnan s
fields.comment:
The hall is spacious.. And the service is really good.
There is a big space for both bike and car parking and people are constantly helping to let us know the parking.
The diner area is also big.. They were able to setup atleast 100 chairs and buffet.

fields.name: Balaji Murugesan
fields.comment: Best hall to conduct marriage functions very spacious good parking. Elegant look and easy to commute. Near to metro station. Very good air conditioning.

fields.name: JEYA RAM S
fields.comment: Very Big and good maintained wedding hall at north Chennai and very near to Toll Gate Metro Station. Spacious dining room, 500+ seating capacity hall, 50+ car park etc.

fields.name: Adhimoorthy k s
fields.comment: Affordable, small Hall for a decent small gathering. Parking is a problem.

fields.name: CHARLES INBARAJ
fields.comment: Very very old small mahal with no much facilities, this place is ok for budget friendly people

fields.name: GLOBE TROTTER
fields.comment:
A classy , contemporary , elegant  Marriage Hall fit for comfortably accommodating 800+ guests . Spread across a large land parcel , there's enough space for about 250 + cars . The drop off / pick up point , the Portico , is wide and well planned to ensure there's no problem for Guests disembarking and those who board . The Stage itself is massive and can hold about 60 persons. Didn't have the opportunity to see the  Rooms , but heard they're top notch and maintained very well. Dining hall that can accommodate 250+ guests . The Marriage Hall ceiling is very high ensuring air circulation and has many exit points . Chairs are sturdy and comfortable. Drapes ,  curtains and other decor are pleasing to the eye and ooze luxury.  The Lawns and Parking area needs more greenery and landscaping - but for this would have given 5 Stars .
To summarise , this should be the first choice for People who'd want their Family Wedding conducted in a grand manner. Cheers

fields.comment: Right from entry to exit, it was a great experience. Be it the ambience inside the palace or outside, neatly planned engineering. Well decorated and maintained.apic and span toilets and floors

fields.name: Mugunthan Chakrapani
fields.comment: This place exactly on the main road just opposite to cresent engineering college in Vandalur, also very close and opposite to Vandalur Zoo. Before I brief about the place, Let me tell my personal experience on how I reached this place. I started from Tambaram railway station by bike. I missed to take extreme left when I was nearing Vandalur Zoo, but my bad I took the center lane and the same took me in Vandalur flyover, then I went for 2 kms to find the U turn and come back another 2 kms to reach this place. While returning back to Tambaram, again I missed to take the extreme left and took the center lane, which took in to flyover taking left and the I took a U turn to reach the road parallel to railway track. Then i travelled around 2 km to find the flyover to cross the track and came back to door step of the Sri Bhavani Palace. So be please be mindful while going returning otherwise it will be absolute Maze for you. Coming back to this place, enough parking space for both 2 wheelers and 4 wheelers. Seperate gate for entry and exit. You can use the lift from parking area to go the function hall in second floor and dining hall in 1st floor or else you have to take the steps. Please mind your step before getting in to lift as floor tiles are not that much flat equivalent to floor steps of lift. Hall size is uneven as the lift occupies the space in the center of the floor, but occupancy level is around 500 people on the float. In the 3rd floor you can find the rooms for stay, but not sure about the no. Of rooms available. Dining hall can hold around 120 to 150 people at time, which is pretty good capacity for this size hall. Always mind to start the function on time to avoid rush on the stage and dining table. Overall this place is good to host all type of functions. Railway station is bit fare from this place, so better go for MTC bus or own vehicle and again you have to be more carefull about the route as I said earlier.

fields.name: Karupa samy
fields.comment: This is a grand venue for all kinds of events. The floors are spacious and neatly maintained. The large dining room and marriage hall had central air conditioning. Only vegetarian functions are allowed. A beautiful marriage hall with a light setting and good design from top to bottom. There is a beautiful temple inside the mahal. The ceiling is completely different, giving it a great look. There is ample parking space. This is a much noticeable venue.

fields.comment: The marriage hall is very conveniently located on GST Road, right opposite Vandalur Zoo. It has lift access to all floors, which is very helpful, especially for elderly guests. Car parking is available, but please note that the right-side parking is fine, while the left-side parking space is quite narrow and there’s a chance of vehicles getting scratched or hit. I would recommend using the lift, as the staircase is a bit steep and not very comfortable for older people.

fields.name: Balaji Suresh
fields.comment:
We organized our son's Aayushya Homam at Vedashreni Hall.

The venue is amazing and aesthetically designed. The thinnai area in the first floor was our favourite.

Sucharita madam explained the rules of the establishment, timings etc

We booked for only the first half of the day.

They will share the contacts of their inhouse decorators and we can proceed with either of them.

Parking will be an issue if you are expecting lot of people coming in their own cars. If needed, they will arrange valet service at an extra charge.

Overall we were satisfied with our experience

fields.name: Jayanthi Raghunathan
fields.comment:
We hosted my son’s Upanayanam at Vedashreni Function Hall, and the experience was truly commendable. The hall itself is elegant, beautifully blending traditional charm with modern aesthetics and requires very minimal decoration. It is exceptionally well-maintained and radiates a classy, serene atmosphere.
Ms. Sucharitha and her team managed the venue with professionalism and efficiency, making the entire process smooth and stress-free. The facility includes three guest rooms: two smaller ones and a larger room that can comfortably accommodate up to 10 guests.
The function hall is located on the second floor, with the dining area on the first floor. A lift is available for easy access. The dining hall can seat around 50 people at a time, while the main hall can comfortably handle a floating crowd of about 170 guests.
One consideration is parking—since the hall is situated on a narrow lane and has limited in-house parking. However, they offer a valet parking service through a trusted contact, which can be arranged for an additional charge.
While the pricing may be on the higher side, the quality, ambiance, and overall experience fully justify the cost. It’s an excellent venue choice for a special occasion.

fields.name: Lavanya Ramasami
fields.comment:
We would like to express our heartfelt thanks to the management of Vedashreni Function Hall and their entire team for the wonderful support extended to us during the Sadhabishekam celebration.

From the meticulous arrangements to the quiet efficiency behind the scenes, every detail was handled with care and devotion, allowing the function to flow smoothly and peacefully. Your cooperation, hospitality, and commitment truly made this sacred occasion comfortable and memorable for all of us.

We are deeply grateful for your support in helping us conduct this auspicious event in such a serene and well-organized manner. Thank you once again for being an integral part of our celebration.

Located on Ritherdon Road near Anita Methodist School, it’s easy for guests to find and reach. The hall’s elegant decor, lighting, and ambiance create a pleasant atmosphere for any occasion.

You can bring your own caterers to serve delicious vegetarian food and desserts. The venue also offers a few rooms for outstation guests, changing rooms for convenience, and limited parking space for those arriving by car.

fields.name: Mariappan S

BKN Auditorium is a good choice for those looking for a spacious and well-equipped venue for their event.

Highly recommend this place for hosting any large-scale event or gathering!

I would also like to mention the manager — he was very patient, polite, and extremely helpful throughout the event. I truly appreciate his involvement and the way he personally took care of every small detail. It shows his genuine dedication to the business.

Just one small suggestion — it would be great if they could improve the outdoor lighting, especially around the trees. Also, placing a clear signboard with the wedding hall’s name and picture on the main road would help guests locate the venue easily, since there are a few other halls nearby.

Other than that, everything was perfect. Highly recommended for family events and reception's

Thanks

fields.name: Rajkumar Aravindan
fields.comment: S. Ezhil Thirumana Mandapam, situated on Thiruvottiyur High Road in Minjur, Tamil Nadu, is a spacious and well-equipped venue ideal for hosting various events, including weddings, receptions, and other social gatherings. The main hall is fully air-conditioned and can comfortably accommodate a large number of guests, ensuring a pleasant experience regardless of the weather. The dining area is also expansive, allowing for efficient service during meal times. One of the standout features of this mandapam is its ample parking space, providing convenience for guests arriving by car. The interior design has been praised for its aesthetic appeal, contributing to the overall ambiance of the venue. Additionally, the mandapam offers multiple rooms for guests, which is beneficial for those hosting multi-day events or accommodating out-of-town attendees. Its strategic location on the main road makes it easily accessible from various parts of the city, and its proximity to Minjur railway station, approximately 2 kilometers away, adds to its accessibility. Overall, S. Ezhil Thirumana Mandapam combines functionality with aesthetic appeal, making it a suitable choice for those seeking a venue that offers both convenience and a pleasant atmosphere for their special occasions.

The hall is quite spacious, clean, and well maintained, with good air-conditioning and a traditional yet modern look. It can easily accommodate large gatherings and offers excellent facilities, including a nice stage setup, projector screens, and ample seating. There is also sufficient parking space for both cars and two-wheelers, which is a big plus. The attached guest rooms are clean and convenient for out-of-town guests. The management was professional and helpful, making sure everything ran smoothly during the event. Catering and decoration options are flexible  you can bring in outside vendors or use their in-house services. Overall, this is a great venue for weddings, receptions, and other large functions in this area. Would definitely recommend it

fields.name: Premnath Ponnuchamy
fields.comment:
Mangalam Thirumana Mahal, Thirumullaivoyal, Chennai, is an exemplary and budget-friendly destination to host your South Indian style marriage and reception ceremony. An aesthetically designed Kalyana Mandapam offering best in class services for making your wedding day a memorable experience. Being strategically located, this venue becomes easily accessible for all to commute. Mangalam Marriage Hall, Thirumullaivoyal, has an enormous banquet hall, perfect for your indoor celebrations. It would enchant your guests with colorful illumination and traditional decor. Also suited to host your birthdays, anniversaries, family get-togethers, pre-wedding ceremonies, cultural programs, and more.
Mangalam Thirumana Mahal, Chennai, can smoothly accommodate a massive gathering for your special day. It offers ample parking space for guests arriving in private vehicles. The team of decor artists present on-site offer the best services with elegant and charming set-ups. They deck up the banquet with traditional ornate accessories, floral backdrops, or customize according to the theme of the event. Mangalam Kalyana Mandapam, Chennai, has magnificent rooms made available for the invitees arriving from other cities for your wedding. Delicious vegetarian and non-vegetarian delicacies are prepared by the cooks present here. You also get the liberty to outsource your catering services so your guests can enjoy a customized multi-cuisine menu or live food counters. Lock in your next blissful affair with Mangalam Thirumana Mahal, Thirumullaivoyal, Chennai.

Happy Visiting 🥳🥳

fields.name: Srinithi Rajendran
fields.comment:
My first time here and I genuinely wish more people invite me to functions at this venue. That is the kind of benchmark this place has set.

It was my cousin brother’s wedding and we had a full vegetarian menu planned across three sessions, dinner, breakfast and lunch. Everything was handled exceptionally well. From the ground staff to the serving team, buffet management, food quality and cleaning crew, the entire operation was super organised, timely and maintained with great discipline.

The venue has great parking space, which makes it very convenient for guests. It also has multiple wedding halls, along with lifts and escalators, making movement smooth and comfortable for elders and large gatherings. The entire space is spacious with a lovely ambience that adds to the overall experience.

They do charge on the higher side, but they ensure the output is consistent and top notch in every aspect of execution. The food quality across all three sessions was impressive and guests were truly satisfied.

The rooms are decent and comfortable, though the washrooms could definitely be improved. However, if your priority is hosting a function with a well executed menu and smooth coordination in a grand setting, this is a great choice.

Highly recommended.

fields.name: Deepika Deivabalan
fields.comment:
We hosted my brother’s wedding and reception at M Weddings & Conventions, Chennai, and the experience was truly wonderful. The entire team was extremely professional, supportive, and kind throughout the event.

Our guests had great feedback about the stay, food, and overall hospitality. The staff attended to every request politely and ensured that our guests were comfortable at all times.

The wedding breakfast and lunch were excellent and widely appreciated by everyone. The décor team was also very patient and accommodating with our requirements, and they executed everything beautifully.

As a family, we were extremely satisfied with the service and hospitality provided by the team at M Weddings & Conventions. We would definitely recommend this venue to our friends and family for their special occasions.

fields.name: Udaya Sankar
fields.comment:
Heartfelt thanks to Chef Umapathi and the entire culinary team at M WEDDING and Conventions for the outstanding buffet arranged on 21st February 2026.

Every dish was delicious, perfectly cooked, and beautifully presented. The variety, authentic taste, and quality truly impressed all our guests, and many personally appreciated the food.

Special compliments to Chef Umapathi for maintaining consistency, hygiene, and rich flavors across the spread. The buffet added great value and elegance to the occasion and made the event even more memorable.

Wishing the team continued success and looking forward to many more wonderful experiences.

fields.name: Srinivasan B

M-Convention is an excellent venue for hosting a wide range of events. The complex houses multiple spacious halls within the same premises, making it highly convenient for conducting parallel functions, conferences, weddings, and large gatherings. The infrastructure is well planned, and the premises are neatly maintained.

One of its major advantages is the ample and well-organized parking space, which comfortably accommodates a large number of vehicles without congestion. In addition to providing the venue, M-Convention also offers catering and event management services, enabling clients to coordinate all event requirements under one roof.

The only drawback is the approach road, as the connectivity and road condition leading to the venue are not very good. However, once inside the premises, the overall facilities and services provide a satisfying experience.

fields.comment:
The hall is located on the outskirts of Chennai, conveniently situated on the main road. The ground floor houses the dining area and is equipped with a ramp for easy access by the elderly and physically challenged. A lift is available to reach the first floor, where the main function hall is located. The hall can accommodate around 500 guests and offers ample car parking space. There is also a spacious open area with a beautifully maintained garden and an attractive water fountain.
However, the toilets require attention — the ladies’ restroom is on the ground floor and the men’s restroom is on the first floor, both of which need basic maintenance improvements. Guest rooms are available on the second floor for stay arrangements.

fields.name: lidiya lavanya

fields.name: Dinesh Kumar Arumugam
fields.comment:
Saidayappa Kalyana Mandapam, situated near Chennai, is an old and renowned venue that can accommodate large crowds.

Its proximity to Poonamallee and ample parking space make it an attractive option. The fully air-conditioned hall has a capacity of over 500 and features a unique two-way staircase. However, the air conditioning could be enhanced for better comfort during hot weather.

Although the venue is pricey, it offers a wide range of amenities, making it suitable for those seeking a luxurious experience. The venue is not only ideal for functions but also for community gatherings.

To maintain high standards of hygiene, improvements to the interior and wash areas are necessary. The dining area, located on the ground floor, offers easy access and can accommodate over 250 guests.

If budget is not a constraint, Saidayappa Kalyana Mandapam is an excellent choice for hosting grand and memorable events.

The main hall is located in first floor and the dining area is located in the ground floor making the perfect balance for the people to roam around without hassles. Overall it can accomodate around 1500~2000 people with all the comforts. The parking area can accommodate around 20 cars. Separate two wheeler parking area also available. Pros:
Prompt response: The manager I spoke to was quick to respond, could communicate in English, and listened to the requirements and concerns before suggesting their packages.

Patient and skilled artists: If we were unhappy with what they did or wanted last minute changes, they redid whatever we asked them to without any push-backs. High-quality products: They use all the products they mention in the catalogs. If you have preferences, you can state them upfront and the team would use the same.

Pricing:
We were charged 24k for party makeup for 2 days (50% advance.) Prices for convenience and extensions, lashes etc. are separate. Please note that the rates are subject to change according to the management.

Cons/Suggestion:
We preferred the work of the senior hair artist on the first day over the artist on second day. The hair on first day lasted longer and they way she did her work was also seamless.

So in case, you are particular about a style and want the best hands, I think you should ask for the senior artists.

I got to know about Ms.Pushpa (Bridal Makeup Studio) through my fiancé, who had seen her amazing work on his friend for their family function. I was really impressed and decided to visit her in person to discuss my engagement look.

When I first met her, I told her that I had never done full-face makeup before and didn’t want to look too heavy or overdone. I even asked for a trial, but she gently told me not to waste my money, she asked me to trust her and promised she would give me the perfect natural look. Her confidence and calm attitude made me feel comfortable right away.

On the engagement day, even though I arrived late, she stayed calm, patient, and completely focused on her work. During the makeup process, I was honestly a bit scared because it felt like she was applying too much at first. But she smiled and reassured me, saying, “Please trust me , I’ll make sure you look your best.” I was still a little nervous, but when I saw the final look, I was completely amazed! She made me look so elegant, glowing, and natural, exactly how I had imagined.

No matter what was happening in the room, even with people talking or other distractions, she never lost focus. I had to change my saree in between the event, and she helped me through the entire process, adjusting my saree beautifully and touching up my makeup to make sure everything stayed perfect. I could truly see her dedication and the 100% effort she put in till the very end.

She used high-quality products, worked with such care, and even waited till the end of my nalangu ceremony to do a final touch-up, which meant so much to me. My family and I were beyond happy with the result.

I’m really glad I chose her, her work truly speaks for itself! Thank you so much for making my special day even more beautiful ❤️

We wanted to have a family photo and was searching for a good photo studio within Medavakkam. I contacted a couple of them but I got good response from Pixeldesign.

We had an excellent set of photos from here. The studio is inside a deadend and is hidden from the main road of Velachery-Tambaram Main Road.

They have 2 options,
1. 30 mins 1000Rs: We can take as many shots and poses and combinations as possible within 30 mins.
2. 100Rs per photo: If we already have a pose in mind and just want to take one then this option is good. If you don't then each click of the photo costs you 100rs. 100rs is not for the photo that you select from many clicks.

I felt the 1st option is great but thought the price is slightly higher. But the setup in the studio was great and photos came out very well for us.

The photographer was very patient with every pose and combination we asked and even adjusted a few poses to get the right photo. Though they had another photoshoot to go for they gave us the right amount of importance and care.

As promised they sent the downloadable drive link for all the photos within 2 days.

I will be visiting them again to frame a couple of those photos.

Improvement Points:
1. The studio is slightly cramped, if they can expand to a bigger place then it would be easy to move around. We were 5 and felt very cramped.
2. A couple of ties could have been kept at the studio to cater for the needs of those who take pictures in suits.

fields.name: Subha Ramiah

I am a Masterchef USA Season 10 Top5 chef who was brought up in Chennai. This week there was an Urgent need to cook for my charity and all of its needy children and parents on the inauguration of Catherine Technical Institute on March 29th, 2025 for http://www.catherinehopefoundation.org

I reached out to Baskaran and Solomon Srinivasan of Envyn Caterers and immediately they responded with an amazing menu and an affordable charity pricing for “Traditional Chennai Biryani Leaf Service” in 24 hrs .

Mr. Solomon personally took responsibility and designed the menu working with me even to make my favorite “Indalian Fruit Salad (Indian+Italian)” for pairing with their amazing Biryani lunch round up.

They came on time with hot food, worked with me on site to prepare “Healthy Juicy Indalian salad” and provided what I call “100/10” food service -10 times more than what I expected.

This review coming from me is from my tastebuds, stomach & of course my heart.  The children have never eaten anything remotely close to this amazing lunch!
They (1st grade to 10th grade active kids) and 10+ disabled kids and their parents) usually eat rice and sambar in a bowl with little portions just to get by!!  This feast was once in a lifetime event for them - thanks to General Manager Mr. Solomon who personally took interest to visit and serve them in his own hand!!!

My Biryani & Raitha in Masterchef competition achieved “Best of Episode” rating from the MC judges “Michelin star Chef Gordon Ramsey, Chef Aaron Sanchez and Mr. Joe Bastianich”… HOWEVER I WAS BLOWN AWAY BY THE TENDER Goat Meat (1 kg Basmati Rice to 1.5kg meat ratio) , Egg Plant Curry, beautify portion packed fruits, Chicken 65, bread halwa, pickle, Raitha and Appalam”

OUR HEARTS AND STOMACH ARE FILLED WITH NUTRITIOUS FOOD AND ENERGY !!!

I would rate their food, cost, service and attitude to carry out the TAMILNADU tradition and Biryani Capital of the world Chennai is outstanding 5/5 stars!!!

fields.name: venkatesh M
fields.comment:
CM Limra Caterers completely ruined my wedding experience.
They handled catering for my engagement in Chennai, and the food quality was good, which is why I trusted them and booked them for both my Christian wedding and traditional wedding in Karaikudi.
However, the traditional wedding on February 22 in Karaikudi was a total disaster.

Despite their promises and claims of being experts—especially biriyani—the biriyani was overcooked, the rice was completely ruined, and the overall quality was far below what they had delivered in Chennai. They had clearly promised no chicken wings, yet wings were found in the biriyani.
They also forgot to add white sesame seeds (ellu) in Chicken 65. When I questioned this, their response was casual and irresponsible—they said they forgot and even claimed it was “not part of the menu.” I honestly don’t understand how Chicken 65 can be served without white sesame seeds.

Other issues:
Parotta was not cooked properly

They offer ponnu mappilai virundhu utter waste they use gimmick words

Their bread halwa is one of the best i know but they ruined that too seriously i can't believe what they did to us

Mutton gravy was below standard
Food quality was nowhere near what they advertised or delivered earlier
I personally spoke to the owners Suhail and Sudarshan, but instead of taking responsibility, they manipulated the situation and kept changing their statements. If customers are not knowledgeable about food, they may believe their explanations—but the reality is very different.

We paid several lakhs, yet they refunded only ₹20,000, which is unacceptable given the damage caused to a once-in-a-lifetime event. On top of this, they cancelled my upcoming event on February 26 at the last minute and refunded the amount when I was already in a very difficult situation.
This experience caused immense stress, embarrassment, and disappointment to my family and guests.
Please think twice before booking CM Limra Caterers, especially for important life events. Based on my experience, they are highly unprofessional and extremely manipulative when things go wrong.

fields.name: Swetha Shankar
fields.comment:
🌟 A Review Straight from the Heart for Saraswathi Catering (Madipakkam) & Mr. Babu 🌟

Some people are born with a special gift, and Mr. Babu of Saraswathi Catering is truly one of them. The way he cooks is nothing short of divine — it feels like food blessed by the gods themselves.

I first tasted his food at the Kamakshi Amman Temple in Karthigeyapuram, and honestly, it felt like I was eating food straight from heaven. Later, at a friend’s function, I couldn’t resist asking who the cook was — and there was Babu, smiling from the corner. From then on, he became our family’s go-to chef for every special occasion.

When my baby’s naming ceremony came, we didn’t think twice — Babu cooked for us, and his rasam was simply out of this world. My mother still talks about that rasam even today!

What touches me most is that Babu doesn’t just serve food — he serves love. During a very difficult time, when we had to arrange food for my mother-in-law’s death ceremonies, our large Brahmin family (who usually never eat outside food during such times) trusted him completely. I just sent him the menu once, and everything came perfectly — no reminders, no tension, just comforting food made with care.

Babu’s smile itself feels like an ingredient — it fills your heart as much as his food fills your stomach. He brings not just flavor, but peace and happiness to everyone he serves.

I truly wish that God blesses Babu with all the health, wealth, and happiness in the world — because he deserves nothing less. 🙏✨

🚨🚨 I had the worst experience with Sai Lakshmi Catering. I booked them based on the Google reviews, but now I seriously doubt how genuine those reviews are. The food quality was very poor and they completely ruined my function.

Another major issue is that if you book for 100 people, they prepare food exactly for 100 people — not even a little extra. In family functions, guest count can slightly vary, and any experienced caterer knows to keep some buffer. This shows a complete lack of planning and responsibility.

This is honestly the worst catering service I have ever seen. If you care about your family function and don’t want unnecessary stress or embarrassment, please think twice before choosing them.

In addition, all the food items were too spicy. Children could not eat, and even many elders left the food without finishing it. The ice cream flavor that we requested was not provided, and we had also asked for beeda, but that was not served either.
The total amount was ₹94,000, and we already paid ₹90,000. Despite this, they spoke very disrespectfully and even used offensive words. We have recorded everything.
People who run a business should behave politely and professionally. They must think before speaking and should not use inappropriate language. We have never seen such a terrible catering service before.

We had recently booked Haritham events for my seemantham and the event was a huge success! Everyone loved the food, the decor, and the overall arrangements. We received so much positive feedback, especially for the food.

Breakfast: The spread was simple and minimal, but very tasty. Though a little on the pricey side, the quality was excellent and the idlis were perfect.

Lunch: Absolutely delicious. The different variety rices, sweets, and ada pradhaman were all appreciated. Thank you for that extra chakka pradhaman.

Souvenir: The cute magnet at the entrance was such a thoughtful touch, the whole family was delighted.

Overall, everyone was really happy, and that meant so much to us—because honestly, my husband and I go to a function mainly for the food! 😅
Hearing appreciation from others as well truly made us happy.

Thanks again, Meera maami, for making it such a memorable experience and for your constant support and assistance throughout the planning and till the end of the event.

fields.comment: We conducted our daughter’s wedding on Feb 6 at Chennai and entrusted Haritham Events with catering and allied services. The food was awesome, aesthetics were tastefully done. Meera especially attended to our calls even in the middle of the night. Everything was professional and well appreciated by all our guests from India and abroad. Wishing them all the best in their future endeavors!!

fields.name: Brindha Kannan
fields.comment:
We recently engaged Haritham Events for our Grahapravesam, and they took care of the decorations, kolam, and catering for us. They truly offer an end-to-end service, which made the entire process smooth and stress-free.

Raghu and Meera were instrumental in helping us finalise the details. A special thanks to Meera, who was always available to clarify our doubts and assist in planning every aspect of the event. Her support truly made a difference and contributed significantly to the success of the occasion.

The catering was excellent—the food was served fresh and hot, even though it was prepared at their T. Nagar kitchen and our home is in Thiruvanmiyur. The tasty food was appreciated by everyone. The service team was attentive and ensured that all our guests were well taken care of.

The mixture and Mysore pak in the thamboolam bag were a big hit with all. We also want to thank them especially for procuring the palm leaf thamboolam bags—they were thoughtful, eco-friendly, and well-received.

The team also paid attention to finer details—like providing a table cover for the reception area table—which reflected their professionalism and thoughtfulness. We’re really happy with their service and would gladly recommend them to anyone looking for professional event management.

fields.name: kalameham ethirajan
fields.comment:
Haritham events Raghu & Meera made us feel they are our family and made all the marriage arrangements like what they would have done for their Daughter and Son.
Every arrangements from Go to Finish is meticulously planned and executed to the fullest satisfaction to both the families and all people who graced the occasion.
Simply extraordinary people and exceptional service with love and care.
Every other function management from our family will be by them for sure.
Ofcourse Raghu and Meera have become my family.

fields.name: Sushma Saparam
fields.comment:
We had so much fun planning a surprise party event for my parents 25th Anniversary  with Haritham Events that even after 6 months people still recall the fun celebrations and the amazing food served by them.

My brother and I had only drawn a rough outline of what we wanted and had clue on how to go about. Plus time differences and lack of time to coordinate had put tremendous pressure on us. The fact that we were visiting India for the special celebrations was totally not known to my parents . So everything had to be hush hush.

All we did was a couple of video calls with Haritham and like magic everything fell in place. Right from booking the venue to curating the menu it was an amazing experience to say the least.

Of course we had to take our close relatives & the special people (who we needed to be there to make it special for my parents) into confidence and it was all done so smoothly through whatsapp groups by Team Haritham

And imagine we met them in person only as we landed in Chennai. It was like a thriller unfolding as we surprised our parents who were shell shocked to see us.

From there all the surprises that Haritham had so meticulously planned unfolded in smooth succession. They had the most brilliant MC and DJ on board who made the evening so lively and full of fun.

And what do i say about the food... wah ..wah..wah... it took us to another level of ecstasy. The Indori Paneer, Bikaneri Gatta, Mungodi Soup, Lacha Paratha.....to name a few.... were out of the world.

We never knew we could have Mango mousse, red velvet mini cup cakes and panacottas for desserts. We had never had them in any wedding before. We were blown away by the options given by Raghu.

All the arrangements were impeccable and their hospitality is to be experienced. Their service staff are always around with a smiling face ready to help with anything.

The happiness on my parent's face that day cannot be described and so precious for my brother & me that we will forever be grateful to them for pulling off such an amazing event. Right from return gifts, the cake to the decor everything was handpicked and fantastic.

Special mention to their photography team. Photographers were so much fun to work with. They made us at ease and looking at all the photographs now gives me goosebumps.

A big shout out to Raghu , Shyamla and Meera for making our event so perfect.  Very difficult to meet such genuine people. If you ask me i would say just give them the date and name the event, sit back and relax. They will deliver an absolutely beautiful, creative and memorable event for you.

fields.name: vijayalakshmi dhandapani
fields.comment:
Exceptional Catering for My Son’s Birthday – Highly Recommended!

Review:
I recently hired this catering service for my son’s 1st birthday celebration after reading their excellent reviews on Google, and I must say they truly lived up to the reputation! From start to finish, everything was handled professionally and with great care.

Food Quality & Taste:
Every dish was outstanding! The Biryani was the star of the show – rich in flavor, perfectly cooked, and truly pakka bhai veetu Biryani, made using the traditional firewood style, which gave it that authentic taste you simply can’t find everywhere. The aroma itself had everyone excited!

The Chicken 65 was crispy, tender, and seasoned to perfection, making it a hit with both kids and adults. The Bread Halwa was divine – soft, sweet, and loaded with flavor and full of badams &. Cashews, just like a homemade delicacy. And the Abugatta ice cream? Fully made up of nuts not more sweet annd it was very subtle. Absolutely amazing! Creamy, chilled just right, and the perfect way to finish a fantastic meal.

Service & Presentation:
The team was on time, well-organized, and maintained everything impeccably. The food was served hot and fresh, and the staff made sure every guest was taken care of without any delay.

Overall Experience:
Choosing this catering service based on Google reviews turned out to be one of the best decisions for our celebration. The quality, taste, and authentic preparation methods made our son’s birthday truly special. A huge thank you to the bhai & entire team for your dedication and outstanding service.

If you want delicious, traditional-style food with amazing service, I highly recommend this catering service. Will definitely book them again for future events!

fields.name: Murugan V

🙏Our experience with Sholinga Caterers (Rangarajan Kannan) for my daughter's wedding on February 21st and 22nd at Swarna Sudharshan Hall was nothing short of divine. In a celebration where food is the heart of the event, they exceeded every expectation, ensuring every guest left happy and satisfied.

Highlights of their service:

* Exceptional Quality: From Vritham tiffin, lunch, dinner, muhurtham tiffin, lunch and Seer Pakshanam to the final Kattu Satham, every morsel was fresh and flavourful. Many guests remarked that they kept going back for more, praising the menu's curated focus on taste over show-offs.

* Proactive & Courteous Staff: The team was incredibly attentive, constantly checking on guests with a sincere "Innum venuma?" Small gestures, such as a dedicated staff member assigned solely to open water bottles, made a massive impact.

* Flawless Organisation: Dining hall transitions were seamless with zero wait times, even with a large crowd. The setup and cleanup were executed perfectly, and the lack of food wastage was a testament to their precise planning.

* All-in-One Excellence: Beyond catering, we utilized their services for Vaidhiga requirements, poo malai vagaira, Mangala Vadhyam etc...  They excelled in every department, treating the event with the personal attention of a close relative.

* Incredible Value: Their pricing is remarkably reasonable given the high standards and professionalism they maintain.

We are deeply grateful to Rangarajan Kannan for making our celebration so memorable and stress-free. If you want a wedding where the food is talked about for Years, we 100% recommend Sholinga Caterers!

fields.name: Suresh Narayanan
fields.comment:
We recently celebrated our daughter’s three-day wedding in Koyambedu, Chennai at Sree Varaaham Wedding Hall, and we had the absolute pleasure of partnering with Marriage Colors as our décor and event coordination team. Looking back, choosing them was one of the best decisions we made for this wedding.

From Day 1 itself, during the Sangeet/Mehndi evening hosted on the rooftop, Marriage Colors set an extraordinary tone for the celebrations.
The lighting design and special effects transformed the rooftop into a magical celebration space. The dance floor setup, vibrant backdrops, and center stage décor were simply phenomenal. Many of our friends and relatives personally appreciated the ambience and overall execution. The buffet layout was equally well organized, allowing us to comfortably meet and greet the groom’s family and guests in a relaxed, festive atmosphere.

Day 2 began with the Vritham ceremony in the morning and concluded with the grand evening reception. The transformation across all three floors of the venue was breathtaking — from the main entrance, patio areas, waterfalls on the ground floor, staircase décor, and main hall entrance to the stage, side setups, Oonjal arrangement, and dining hall. For the reception, the bride and groom had selected a specific color theme, and Marriage Colors meticulously coordinated their fresh flower arrangements to match the palette across the entire venue. The result was elegant, cohesive, and visually stunning.

One of the most critical and sensitive events was the Janavasam procession from the temple to the hall along a public road — a deeply meaningful tradition for our family. We were concerned about traffic management and public safety. Marriage Colors coordinated seamlessly with the venue and local authorities to ensure smooth traffic flow while allowing us to enjoy the celebration stress-free. Their planning and execution here were truly outstanding.

On Day 3, for the wedding ceremony, we requested a completely traditional theme. Without hesitation, the team transformed the entire ambiance from contemporary elegance to classic tradition. Every guest who attended the ceremony enquired about the décor team, and we were proud to provide numerous referrals.

Beyond décor, Marriage Colors played a broader coordination role by recommending trusted vendors for the venue, catering, makeup, special effects, MC and DJ for Sangeet, instrumental band for reception, Mehndi artists, fireworks, Sandamelam during Janavasam, and more. Their ecosystem of vendors contributed significantly to the overall grandeur and success of the wedding. Every member of the Marriage Colors team worked tirelessly — Pradeep, Sudakar, Rajesh, Rashmi, Lokesh, Elamparithi, Dharani, Chandru, and Siva. Special thanks to Sudakar and Rajesh for their personal attention throughout all three days. Sudakar, in particular, was an absolute pleasure to work with.

Finally, our heartfelt gratitude to Pradeep from Marriage Colors — the driving force behind the entire event. Our conversations began over a year ago and continued even after the wedding concluded. Pradeep’s professionalism, warmth, constant guidance, and friendly reassurance made this journey not only successful but memorable. We genuinely cannot imagine having executed such a grand and seamless wedding without his support.

The success and grandeur of a wedding truly depend on the right vendor partnership. Marriage Colors exceeded our expectations in every way. We wholeheartedly thank the entire team and their leadership for delivering an unforgettable experience. We highly recommend Marriage Colors to anyone looking to host a truly exceptional family celebration and look forward to partnering with them again in the future.

— Suresh, Geetha & Family

fields.name: Nerissa T
fields.comment:
My husband and I selected Marriage Colours for our haldi, reception and wedding. We had an excellent experience with them on all fronts, and would strongly recommend them. 5 stars!

Pre-engagement
We first met Pradhyumna Venkat in Singapore about 7 months before our event. We came out of the meeting with a positive impression. We appreciated that he was very helpful and generous with his time even before we formally engaged his team. For instance, he recommended a number of different venues in Chennai and checked with them on their availability.

Planning
Throughout the planning process, the team’s experience really shone. They took us through each stage of the planning process in a professional and reassuring manner. As we had a strong view and vision of how our events should turn out, we liked that the team took in all our detailed feedback and incorporated them capably, but still made it a point to advise us and provide clear guidance where needed. We had a large number of long calls with them to run through the details, and the team showed great patience and professionalism with us.

Service Model
We liked their approach of charging us a professional service fee for their planning work, but otherwise asking us to settle directly with the various vendors, after negotiating on our behalf. They had no issues with us deviating from their recommended service providers  and often got us better rates than we were willing to pay. At no point did we get a feeling that they were acting with misaligned incentives or overcharging us. Negotiations on costs for their in-house services seemed to be in good faith. They were diligent enough in their account keeping and tracked everything in spreadsheets.

They were always delighted in going the extra mile (e.g. groom's birthday surprise for the bride). Occasionally, they insisted politely against our judgement, and often those decisions turned out to be big winners.

Vendors
MC provided detailed and useful recommendations on vendors and service providers. Most of the vendors were chosen based on their recommendations (see list below). We were very happy with the services provided. It seemed to us that they were not pocketing anything from these vendors.

Ritam and Taranga (venue)
Citadines (guest accommodation)
Crownstone by Revathi (makeup)
Bala Tourist Service & Swarna Travels (guest transport)
Uncle Sam’s (food)
Indosoul (band)
Srinivas (choreographer)
Picturemakers (photographer)
Colours of India (dancers)
Flair Monsters (bartender)

Decor
We spent a lot of time conceptualising the decor with MC. We were very satisfied with the final decor for our three main events. The details were carefully executed,  and the decor team used their discretion to make some smart decisions on some details which we had not previously discussed.

Actual event
All the events went smoothly. MC handled last minute changes and requests capably. Most importantly, our guests had a wonderful time, and they had glowing feedback about their overall experience.

There were some minor hiccups in the guest communications, as some of our guests did not receive prompt replies. The RSVP management process could have also been started earlier and better designed. However, we did not think that these detracted from the overall excellent experience.

Note of appreciation
We would like to thank Lokesh Prabhu, who is the lead wedding planner and main POC for communications with us. He is detail oriented, extremely patient, competent, really passionate about his job, and went above and beyond for us.

Other team members who worked with us and who similar provided excellent service are:
- Pradeep Chandar (creative director)
- Uma Rajesh (gift and catering management)
- Dharani (invites and stationary)
- Muralitharan (travel and logistics)
- Pralob (stalls and onsite coordination)
- Chandru (onsite coordination)
- Sanjana (guest hospitality and onsite coordination)
- Ramachandran (ritual management)
- Kalaivaanan (backend support and coordination)
- Elayaraja (backend support and coordination)
