fields.name: evita joseph
fields.comment:
We hired Green House Productions for our wedding, which included a Jewish ceremony (something they were doing for the first time), and the entire team was patient, flexible, and supportive throughout the entire process.

Even with numerous changes — including last-minute updates just a few hours before the events — they never once said no. They always responded with “sure,” and somehow everything was executed perfectly.

The décor and overall theme looked exactly like what I had envisioned — if anything, it was even better than I imagined. They made the entire process feel effortless and were genuinely so easy to work with.

A special shoutout for the floral décor: I was very particular about not having too many roses and really wanted tulips incorporated into the arrangements. The chuppah and my bridal bouquet were exactly what I wanted and turned out absolutely beautiful.

Anirudh and Unnati were amazing — they stayed in constant communication with us and the venue, and because we live in the U.S., we also had to coordinate calls across different time zones. They made everything seamless with their responsiveness and organization. Wedding planning can be stressful, but they minimized stress significantly and truly made the process smoother.

They also stayed true to the agreed budget, with transparent costs and no hidden surprises, which we really appreciated.

Most importantly, because of their hard work and seamless coordination, we were able to fully enjoy our wedding celebration and be present for every moment.

We are so grateful for everything they did and would 100% recommend Green House Productions to anyone looking for a reliable, creative, and hardworking event management team.

He planned the decor so well for each event based on our outfits, event theme and venue as well as accommodating our requests while keeping every single detail in mind. They made our 3 days long wedding a HUGE success! Most importantly, he kept within our budget without any compromises in quality and he was quick to find alternative solutions when required.

He functioned without the need for any follow-ups and he is contactable at all times, has a responsive team and he is absolutely amazing when it comes to execution and on time handover! All our guests were in complete awe seeing all the amazing deco, they kept asking who was our vendor and they were all full of praises!

You can trust Green House Productions and Anirudh any day without a doubt and your event will definitely look amazing for sure! Highly recommended!

Every element was thoughtfully arranged, creating a visually appealing and well-coordinated setup. The lighting added warmth and charm to the celebration, while the sound system was clear and well balanced throughout the program, ensuring a smooth experience for performers and audience alike.
What truly stood out was Mr. Tyson’s attention to detail, his ability to visualize the end result, and his seamless execution. The entire décor came together beautifully, transforming the outdoor space into a festive and inviting venue.
We are extremely happy with the services provided by Delite Decors and would highly recommend Mr. Tyson and his team for any event. Their dedication, creativity, and reliability made our Christmas celebration truly memorable. 🎄✨

fields.name: Nisha Senthil Babu
fields.comment:
If you're seeking a blend of artistry and passion, look no further than the talented hands of Nethra. I recently indulged in her mehendi magic, and oh, what an enchanting experience it was!
Being blessed with a darker complexion, I've always fretted about how the mehendi stain would turn out. But behold, the results were beyond my wildest dreams! The rich hue, courtesy of her meticulously crafted paste, left me in awe.
What truly sets Nethra apart is her unwavering dedication to perfection. Since our school days, I've entrusted my hands solely to her artistic prowess, and each time, she exceeds all expectations. Her passion for her craft radiates through every stroke, leaving a trail of admiration in its wake.
Not only does she possess a knack for intricate designs, but her warmth and friendliness elevate the entire experience. From start to finish, Nethra ensures her clients feel not just satisfied, but truly cherished.
And let's talk about those aftercare tips – pure gold! Following her advice has worked wonders for maintaining the vibrancy of the stain, leaving my hands adorned with beauty for days on end.
For anyone in search of a mehendi maestro, look no further than Nethra. I wholeheartedly recommend paying a visit to her Instagram page and securing her services for your next occasion. Trust me, you won't be disappointed – you'll be spellbound.

I have been working with 3D Events for over 12 years now, and every single time, they continue to exceed my expectations. This isn’t just a review—it's my heartfelt appreciation for the outstanding service they consistently deliver.

From the very beginning, booking an event with 3D Events is always smooth and hassle-free. Their communication is clear, timely, and professional. I truly appreciate how they walked me through every detail, from sound systems to special entry setups, ensuring I felt confident and informed at every step.

Whenever I requested videos or photos of past events, they promptly provided exactly what I needed, which helped me visualize the setup and make decisions easily. What impressed me the most is the way they sent timely reminders leading up to the event—this gave me so much peace of mind, knowing that everything was being taken care of without me having to follow up.

On the event day, their team arrived early and completed the setup an hour before the start time, with an impressive and elegant presentation. The quality of their equipment and service truly elevated the event to the next level. Every staff member was courteous, professional, and incredibly supportive throughout the entire event.

After more than a decade of working with 3D Events, I can confidently say they not only maintain their high standards but continue to improve year after year. Thank you for always going above and beyond. Keep up the fantastic work—cheers!

fields.name: Sona E
fields.comment:
Edit to review:

I later asked for 20 more cards and was told that 15 extra cards were already printed and available. I said I’d happily take those 15 easy, right?

Since they were already printed and I had paid a lower per-piece price just a month ago, I naturally expected the same rate. Instead, I was told the price is now higher because the quantity is lower. I fully understand this logic for a new job. But in this case, I was basically adopting already-printed cards that were sitting there like, “Please take us.”

Still, I paid. Because inner peace > price discussions.

What I didn’t pay for, was the rude attitude.

When I politely asked about the price difference, Mr. Vijay Jain replied in a rude and dismissive tone and dropped the iconic line:
“We are not selling gold to keep increasing prices.”

Sir… agreed.
But I also wasn’t buying gold.
Just wedding cards.
With emotional attachment.

They genuinely have beautiful cards and excellent work — unfortunately, the customer experience comes with a complimentary stress test.

I truly had plans to come back for my other invitations and recommend them to my friends and family. After this visit, I will now only recommend them… to people I don’t like. (Just kidding. Mostly.)

From the moment I walked into the store, the vibe was not “Welcome!”  it was more “Why are you back?” I honestly felt like I was asking for a favour, not placing a paid order.

By the end of the conversation, choosing another printer felt easier than choosing my wedding outfit.

Great cards. Tough conversations.

fields.name: Bhaskar MC
fields.comment:
In 2015 my good friend gave me one of the most unique and memorable wedding invites I ever had the pleasure of receiving, made by a designer based in Chennai. I held onto it with the hopes that one fine day, I would find the makers and visit their store.

10 years later- I track down the business to a local shop, and take my fiancée to the Lotus Invitations storefront in T. Nagar, where we were immediately blown away by the vast collection of available card designs. The creativity and quality put into each and every design was impressive, and it didn't take long for us to find exactly what we were looking for.

We were greeted by the amazing Ms. Adhi Lakshmi, who has owned the business since 2009. She took care of us with her suggestions, recommendations, and patience: answering every question we threw at her. Nothing was off the table, every customisation was available and every option possible - from paper GSM thickness to bulk pricing to custom artwork - her response was always "I can do that for you."

After making a selection and receiving a quote, we commissioned Lotus for a small order, with half of the cards to be sent to Australia via Int'l courier (at extra cost). The drafting process was quick and timely, and the turnaround between placing the final order and receiving the invites was mere weeks, with Int'l shipping arriving in 4-5 days (DHL recommended). While it was a tad more expensive than other card designers, the per card cost can be made cheaper for larger orders, please ask the staff for how you can customise your order.

Receiving our wedding cards has been nothing short of a dream come true, and we couldn't be happier with the results. Thank you Ms. Adhi Lakshmi and the graphics + printing team at Lotus for the care and incredible customer service - we will definitely be sending people your way!

Embarking on the journey to find the perfect bridal jewelry led me to the enchanting world of Haritha Bridal Jewelry, and my experience was nothing short of magical. From the moment I stepped into the store, I was greeted by a mesmerizing display of exquisite pieces that spoke volumes about craftsmanship and attention to detail.

Haritha Bridal Jewelry boasts a diverse selection that caters to a myriad of tastes and preferences. Whether you're envisioning a modern, contemporary look or a more traditional and classic ensemble, Haritha has curated a collection that effortlessly blends elegance with individuality. Each piece tells a story of artistry, with intricate designs that capture the essence of a bride's unique style.

What truly sets Haritha apart is the unparalleled customer service. The staff at Haritha is not only knowledgeable but also genuinely passionate about helping brides find the perfect jewelry to complement their special day. Their patience, expertise, and personalized approach create an atmosphere that goes beyond a typical shopping experience—it feels like you're being guided by friends who understand the significance of the occasion.

The store's ambiance is tastefully designed, creating an inviting space that allows brides to explore the treasures within. The well-lit displays, comfortable seating, and large mirrors add to the overall allure, making the process of selecting jewelry an enjoyable and memorable affair.

Haritha Bridal Jewelry also excels in customization, ensuring that every bride can wear a piece that resonates with her unique vision. The process is seamless, and the end result is a bespoke creation that reflects the individuality of the wearer. The level of detail and craftsmanship in the customization process is truly commendable.

Despite the luxurious feel of the jewelry, Haritha Bridal Jewelry understands the importance of catering to different budgets. The range of price points ensures that brides can find something exquisite within their financial parameters, without compromising on quality.

In conclusion, my experience at Haritha Bridal Jewelry was a delightful journey of discovery and refinement. If you're in search of bridal jewelry that seamlessly combines elegance, quality, and personalized service, Haritha is the ultimate destination. I left the store not just with stunning jewelry but with a sense of confidence, knowing that I had discovered the perfect pieces to adorn myself on my special day. Haritha Bridal Jewelry truly lives up to its promise of where elegance meets perfection.

fields.name: Nithya
fields.comment:
I recently purchased silver jewellery worth over ₹15,000 from this shop and was quite disappointed with the payment experience.

At the time of billing, I informed them I would be paying a small portion of ₹4200+ through debit card and ₹10,600 through other means (chit savings) Before proceeding, I specifically asked whether their card machine accepted international debit cards, and they confirmed it did, but only after that, they added that they would charge an additional 3.5% on the card transaction.
This surcharge was applied even though:

The transaction was processed in Indian rupees, with no currency conversion involved.

My bank charges zero foreign conversion fees for INR payments, meaning the shop would receive the full amount requested.

The Merchant Discount Rate (MDR), the fee banks charge merchants for processing card payments, is meant to be absorbed by the merchant in India, not passed on to the customer, according to RBI guidelines.

I found this unreasonable and refrained from using my international card altogether. In the end, I had to ask my father to pay the full amount using his locally issued Indian debit card to avoid the unnecessary surcharge.

While I appreciate the craftsmanship of their jewellery, this practice of adding an undisclosed surcharge at the point of payment feels both unprofessional and against the spirit of fair trade. Customers should be informed of all additional charges upfront, especially when they are contrary to standard RBI norms.

It’s disappointing that a store selling high-value items chooses to burden customers with extra fees rather than price their goods accordingly or absorb the MDR as most reputable merchants do.
To make matters worse, they even forgot to give us the invoice with our purchase. We only realized after getting home and checking all the boxes, no bill at all. Now we have to make another trip back to the shop just to collect the invoice. Beautiful jewellery, but hidden fees and sloppy billing make for a frustrating experience.

Many guests appreciated how smoothly the wedding rituals were performed at M Convention, and how the priest guided us with patience throughout the ceremony. The coordination with the wedding team and maintaining muhurtham timing was excellent.

fields.name: Uro KS
fields.comment:
It is an absolute pleasure to write this review for Atulya - a family (not just a team) of committed professionals led by their founder manager, Vidhya. This is going to be a lengthy review so I beg the reader’s indulgence.

Our daughter Shwetha’ wedding was slated for mid-Nov 2023 and we first contacted Vidhya in April 2023. Right from that first interaction (we live in Dubai so all our meetings were via Zoom) we felt very impressed - she had a very calm and reassuring demeanour, exuding an air of quiet confidence. Our going into every little granular detail during planning of the wedding was met with provision of rational solutions and alternatives without ever getting frustrated, regardless of our repetitive probing and questioning - and a trademark quiet and reassuring response from Vidhya as well as her team.

We had planned some outdoor events during the 3 days in Radisson Blu Temple Bay resort. As it was the monsoon season, Vidhya and her team offered a Plan B alternative for each event in case it rained.

Needless to say, come crunch time - their team worked with military precision and it was Plan B that had to be implemented as the weather forecast played soil-sport.

We were absolutely impressed with the decor options that they offered for each event - it was their simple but elegant choices which kind of attracted us towards Atulya in the first place. Their coordination with the bride’ color palette and suggestions eventually worked like magic and made each event absolutely wonderful and memorable.

fields.title: The Complete Tamil Wedding Planning Checklist — 12 Months to Your Big Day
fields.excerpt: Everything you need to plan a Tamil wedding — from fixing the muhurtham to the last-minute details. A month-by-month checklist so nothing slips through the cracks.
fields.content:
Planning a Tamil Wedding?

Planning a Tamil wedding is one of the most joyful — and complex — tasks a family can take on. Between the engagement, the nalangu, the muhurtham, the reception, and everything in between, there are hundreds of decisions to make. This checklist breaks it all down, month by month, so you never miss a thing.

🗓️ 12 Months Before

  • ✅ Fix the wedding date — Work with your family pandit to choose an auspicious muhurtham. Have 2–3 date options ready in case your first choice is already taken by your venue or vendors.
  • ✅ Set your total budget — Decide on a realistic overall budget before booking anything. Divide it across: venue, catering, jewellery, photography, décor, clothing, invitations, and honeymoon.
  • ✅ Finalise the guest list — Get a rough headcount from both families. This directly affects your venue size, catering quantity, and invitation count.
  • ✅ Start venue search — Popular wedding halls in Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, and other Tamil cities book up 10–12 months in advance. Visit at least 3–4 venues before deciding.

🗓️ 9 Months Before

  • ✅ Book your venue — Once you have confirmed the muhurtham date, book the venue immediately. Pay the advance and get a written agreement.
  • ✅ Book photographer and videographer — Good photographers are booked out fast. Review portfolios, watch full wedding films, and confirm the team that will actually shoot your wedding.
  • ✅ Book the caterer — Taste the food before confirming. Decide on South Indian traditional menu, fusion, or a combination. Discuss the number of items, serving style, and staff count.
  • ✅ Start bridal jewellery shopping — Bridal jewellery takes time — especially if you want custom-made pieces. Visit jewellers early to allow for design and making time.

🗓️ 6 Months Before

  • ✅ Book makeup artist — Bridal makeup artists are in high demand. Do a trial session 2–3 months before the wedding to finalise your look.
  • ✅ Book decorator — Share your colour palette and theme. Ask to see photos from weddings they have done at your venue.
  • ✅ Book DJ or nadaswaram artists — Book a DJ for the reception and/or a nadaswaram & thavil team for the muhurtham and procession.
  • ✅ Book mehandi artist — A good mehandi artist can do intricate full-hand bridal mehandi. Book early and show reference photos.
  • ✅ Order wedding outfits — Silk sarees and wedding dhotis take 6–8 weeks to weave if custom-ordered. Visit Kanchipuram or your local silk shop now.

🗓️ 4 Months Before

  • ✅ Design and print wedding invitations — Order 20% more cards than your guest count. Keep digital e-invite versions ready for WhatsApp sharing.
  • ✅ Plan the muhurtham programme — Work with your pandit to finalise the sequence — Ganapathy homam, Nalangu, Manam Kottal, Thali tying, Sapthapathi, Aashirvadam.
  • ✅ Plan honeymoon — Book flights and hotels early, especially for peak season (December–January, April–May).
  • ✅ Book travel and transport — Arrange wedding cars for the bride, groom, and family.

🗓️ 2 Months Before

  • ✅ Send invitations — Send physical cards and follow up with WhatsApp digital invites.
  • ✅ Finalise return gifts — Decide on return gifts for guests — steel items, silk scarves, dry fruits, or customised gift boxes. Order in bulk.
  • ✅ Book hotel rooms for outstation guests — Block rooms at a nearby hotel for guests travelling from other cities.
  • ✅ Confirm all vendor bookings — Call every vendor and reconfirm the date, time, and location.

🗓️ 1 Month Before

  • ✅ Finalise seating and stage layout — Share a floor plan with your decorator. Decide on the stage backdrop design, flower arrangements, and entry arch.
  • ✅ Final costume fittings — Try on your complete bridal look together — saree, blouse, jewellery, and footwear. Make alterations if needed.
  • ✅ Prepare vendor payment schedule — Note down final payment amounts and due dates for all vendors.
  • ✅ Prepare a detailed event day schedule — List every event with its start time and share it with your family coordinator.

🗓️ 1 Week Before

  • ✅ Re-confirm all vendors with addresses and timings — share the full venue address (Google Maps pin) with every vendor.
  • ✅ Delegate tasks to family members — welcome guests, coordinate food, manage vendor payments.
  • ✅ Pack your bridal kit — saree pins, safety pins, touch-up makeup, energy snacks, phone charger.
  • ✅ Rest and sleep well.

🎊 On the Wedding Day

  • ✅ Wake up early — muhurtham waits for no one
  • ✅ Eat a proper breakfast before getting ready
  • ✅ Have a trusted coordinator manage the timeline
  • ✅ Trust your vendors — you have done the groundwork
  • ✅ Be present. Breathe. Enjoy every moment.

fields.title: How to Set a Wedding Budget — A Practical Guide for Tamil Families
fields.excerpt: Wedding costs in Tamil Nadu vary widely. Here is a realistic, category-by-category budget breakdown to help you plan without overspending or surprises.
fields.content:
One of the first and most important conversations in wedding planning is about money. Many families delay it — and then scramble when bookings pile up. Here is a practical, honest guide to building a wedding budget in Tamil Nadu.

💰 The Three Budget Tiers

Before breaking it down, know which tier your wedding falls into:

  • Budget Wedding (₹5L–₹15L): Intimate, 150–300 guests, one or two functions, local vendors.
  • Mid-Range Wedding (₹15L–₹40L): 300–600 guests, two to three functions, established vendors, decorated hall.
  • Premium Wedding (₹40L–₹1Cr+): 600+ guests, multiple functions, top photographers, luxury décor, outstation honeymoon.

Most Tamil family weddings in cities like Chennai, Coimbatore, and Madurai fall in the ₹15L–₹40L range.

📊 Category-Wise Breakdown (Mid-Range ₹25L Wedding)

CategoryBudget Range
🏛️ Venue₹2,00,000 – ₹4,00,000
🍽️ Catering (400 guests)₹3,00,000 – ₹6,00,000
💎 Jewellery₹3,00,000 – ₹8,00,000
📷 Photography & Video₹1,00,000 – ₹2,50,000
💄 Bridal Makeup₹25,000 – ₹80,000
🌸 Décor & Flowers₹1,50,000 – ₹3,00,000
👗 Wedding Outfits₹1,00,000 – ₹2,00,000
✉️ Invitations₹30,000 – ₹60,000
🌿 Mehandi₹15,000 – ₹40,000
🎶 DJ / Music₹30,000 – ₹75,000
🎁 Return Gifts₹50,000 – ₹1,50,000
🕌 Pandit / Priest₹20,000 – ₹50,000
✈️ Honeymoon₹50,000 – ₹2,00,000
🔧 Miscellaneous₹50,000

💡 5 Money-Saving Tips

  1. Book vendors early. Last-minute bookings cost 20–40% more.
  2. Fix the guest list before booking catering. Every additional 50 guests adds ₹30,000–₹60,000.
  3. Compare at least 3 vendors per category. Prices vary widely for the same quality.
  4. Negotiate packages. Photographers, decorators, and makeup artists often bundle services — ask.
  5. Track every expense in real time. Use the Budget Planner on WedMangal to log spending and stay on target.

A clear budget set at the beginning makes every subsequent decision easier. Know your limits, stick to them, and remember — a beautiful wedding is about the love and family, not the price tag.

fields.title: 7 Tamil Wedding Rituals Every Couple Should Know
fields.excerpt: From the Nalangu to the Sapthapathi, Tamil weddings are rich with meaning. Here is a simple guide to the key rituals and what they symbolise.
fields.content:
Tamil weddings are among the most beautifully elaborate in the world. Every ritual has centuries of tradition and deep meaning behind it. If you are getting married or attending a Tamil wedding for the first time, here is a guide to the key ceremonies.

🪔 1. Nalangu (Pre-Wedding Celebration)

Nalangu is a joyful pre-wedding ceremony usually held the evening before the muhurtham. The bride and groom are seated facing each other and teased playfully by family members with games — rolling limes, making them reach for garlands, and feeding each other sweets.

It is a moment of lightness before the solemnity of the main ceremony. Turmeric paste is applied to the couple for a healthy glow, which is why you will often see brides with a yellow tint on their skin on the wedding day.

🌺 2. Kashi Yatrai (Groom's Mock Departure)

In this charming ritual, the groom pretends he wants to renounce the world and go to Kashi (Varanasi) to study the Vedas. He carries an umbrella, a fan, and a small bundle as if setting off on a pilgrimage.

The bride's father intercepts him, argues that his daughter is the right life partner, and convinces him to return and get married instead. The groom agrees, turns around, and the wedding proceeds. It is symbolic of the choice between the life of a sanyasi and the life of a householder.

💍 3. Oonjal (The Swing Ceremony)

The Oonjal is one of the most visually stunning parts of a Tamil wedding. The bride and groom sit on a decorated swing while family women sing traditional Carnatic songs, gently pushing the swing.

The swaying of the swing symbolises the ups and downs of married life and the couple's commitment to face them together. Women throw flowers on the couple and exchange betel leaves and bananas.

🔥 4. Homam (The Sacred Fire)

The pandit lights a sacred fire — the Agni — which acts as a witness to all the wedding vows. The couple sits before the fire and the groom's sister ties the corners of the groom's dhoti to the bride's saree (symbolising their union).

Ghee, rice, and sacred herbs are offered into the fire with chanting of Vedic mantras. Every offering is a prayer for the couple's prosperity, health, and long life.

🌿 5. Manam Kottal (Tying of the Thali)

This is the central moment of the Tamil wedding — equivalent to exchanging rings in a Western ceremony. The groom ties the sacred thali (mangalsutra) around the bride's neck as the nadaswaram plays and family members shower flowers.

The thali is tied with three knots — representing the wife's commitment to her husband, her family, and God. Once the thali is tied, the couple is married in the eyes of family, society, and the divine.

👣 6. Sapthapathi (The Seven Steps)

Derived from Sanskrit meaning "seven steps," this ritual involves the couple walking seven steps together around the sacred fire, each step representing a vow:

  1. Nourishment — we will provide for each other.
  2. Strength — we will grow strong together.
  3. Prosperity — we will share our wealth.
  4. Happiness — we will seek joy together.
  5. Children — we will be blessed with children.
  6. Seasons — we will live through all seasons of life.
  7. Friendship — we will be lifelong companions and friends.

After the seventh step, the couple is bound by vows taken before God and family.

🎊 7. Reception

The reception is usually held in the evening of the wedding day or the following day. The couple is dressed in fresh outfits and greets every guest personally. It is a celebration for extended family and colleagues who may not have attended the morning muhurtham.

Modern Tamil receptions often include live music, DJ performances, and elaborate stage décor.

Understanding these rituals makes any Tamil wedding more meaningful — whether you are the bride, groom, or a guest. Each step is a thread in the beautiful fabric of Tamil culture and tradition.
